Like metals tested in a furnace, the leaders and companies driving this technology are being tested by its potential and the praise it garners. The calls for caution from within the industry itself suggest a recognition that unchecked progress can lead to unforeseen...
reflection.zh: 文章所描述的人工智能的快速发展，呈现了一个强大的新领域。正如金属在熔炉中被试炼一样，引领这项技术的领导者和公司正受到其潜力和所获赞誉的考验。行业内部发出的谨慎呼吁表明，人们认识到不受约束的进步可能导致无法预见的危险，这促使人们采取一种更审慎的方法，优先考虑安全和伦理考量。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: An unexpected move by the US has sparked anger from China and Russia
title.zh: 美国出人意料的举动引发中俄愤怒

summary.en: Russia and China have expressed alarm at the revelation, warning against the idea of space becoming a "battlefield". The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a move that has sparked anger from China and Russia.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯和中国对这一消息表示震惊，警告太空可能成为“战场”。美国首次证实已在太空部署武器，此举引发了中国和俄罗斯的愤怒。

body.en:
The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In his remarks to the Air and Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference on Tuesday AEST, Meink also said the Air Force was adding more autonomous systems to its capabilities and predicted the service would look "radically different" by 2032.

For example, he foresaw one-way attack drones replacing artillery as the "primary killer".

Analysts said that the revelation by the US confirmed an open secret, but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with China and the risk of a weapons race in space.

In 2019, during his first term, US President Donal Trump created the Space Force as a separate military branch. In his second term, he has announced the Golden Dome missile defence system, which includes plans to put US weapons in space.

Trump said last year that he expected the system would be "fully operational before the end of my term", which ends in January 2029.

He said the system would have the capability of intercepting missiles "even if they are launched from space".

Trump also directed the Pentagon to pursue the space-based interceptors in an executive order during the first week of his presidency.

The Congressional Budget Office estimated that just the space-based components of the Golden Dome could cost as much as US$542 billion ($760 billion) over the next 20 years.

For the US, both Russia and China — its two main geopolitical rivals — pose potential threats to US interests in space.

China "develops and operates space and counterspace capabilities as part of a military modernisation strategy," according to the US Space Force.

Russia, meanwhile, "views space as a...
body.zh: 美国首次确认已在太空部署武器，这是在警告俄罗斯等国家可能将长期在条约中达成的仅用于和平目的的全球前沿武器化之后，这是一个引人注目的启示。 美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，美国已经部署了“能够保护联合部队免受敌对行动攻击的在轨太空控制武器”。 梅克没有详细说明这些武器是什么、它们如何工作，或者它们是否针对太空或地球上的其他物体。 美国两年前曾警告称，俄罗斯正在开发一种新的天基反卫星武器，尽管白宫当时表示危险并未迫在眉睫。 但有关反卫星武器的报道反映了人们长期以来对俄罗斯和中国太空威胁的担忧，因为美国的大部分基础设施都依赖于卫星通信。美国此前也展示了自己从地球击落卫星的能力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 梅克在澳大利亚东部标准时间周二举行的美国空军协会航空、航天和网络会议上发表讲话时还表示，空军正在为其能力添加更多自主系统，并预测到 2032 年该军种将“截然不同”。 例如，他预见单向攻击无人机将取代火炮成为“主要杀手”。 分析人士表示，美国的披露证实了一个公开的秘密，但公布的时机可能会加剧与中国的紧张关系以及太空武器竞赛的风险。 2019 年，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在其第一任期内创建了太空军，作为一个独立的军事部门。在他的第二个任期内，他宣布了金顶导弹防御系统，其中包括将美国武器部署到太空的计划。 特朗普去年表示，他预计该系统将“在我的任期结束前全面投入运行”，任期将于 2029 年 1 月结束。 他表示，该系统将具有拦截导弹的能力，“即使它们是从太空发射的”。 特朗普还在就任总统的第一周内发布行政命令，指示五角大楼追捕天基拦截器。 国会预算办公室估计，未来 20 年，仅金顶的太空部分就可能花费高达 5,420 亿美元（7,600 亿美元）。 对于美国来说，俄罗斯和中国这两个主要的地缘政治对手都对美国的太空利益构成潜在威胁。 美国太空军表示，中国“发展和运营太空和反太空能力，作为军事现代化战略的一部分”。 与此同时，俄罗斯“将太空视为......

reflection.en: The ancient prophetic vision of Isaiah, that nations would 'beat their swords into plowshares,' speaks to our deepest hopes for peace. Yet, the news of weapons being deployed in space, a frontier long envisioned for peaceful exploration, raises concerns about a new arms race. May wisdom guide nations to prioritize cooperation and shared stewardship of this...
reflection.zh: 以赛亚先知古老的预言，即列国将“把刀打成犁头”，触及我们对和平最深切的盼望。然而，太空这一曾被设想为和平探索之地的疆域，如今却传出部署武器的消息，这引发了对新军备竞赛的担忧。愿智慧引导列国，在广阔的太空疆域上，优先考虑合作与共同管理，而非冲突。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: AI models chatting in ‘surreal’ dialect mixing poetic language and tech bro jargon
title.zh: 人工智能模型以一种混合了诗意语言和科技行业术语的超现实方言进行聊天

summary.en: Experts are concerned about AI language that resembles James Joyce's prose and tech bro jargon, making monitoring and oversight difficult. AI agents are rapidly developing new dialects that are hard for humans to comprehend, posing challenges for behavior monitoring.
summary.zh: 专家们对人工智能语言表示担忧，这种语言既有詹姆斯·乔伊斯式的散文风格，又有科技行业的行话，使得监控和监督变得困难。人工智能代理正在迅速发展新的方言，人类难以理解，这对行为监控构成了挑战。

body.en: Experts air concern over AI lingo redolent of James Joyce’s prose that is creating barriers to monitoring and oversight AI models have begun communicating in a strange new version of English that reads like a cross between James Joyce’s Finnegans Wake and tech bro jargon, new research has found. Autonomous AI agents are rapidly creating novel dialects allowing them to converse in an often barely comprehensible language, which risks making it harder for humans to monitor their behaviour. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们对让人想起詹姆斯·乔伊斯散文的人工智能术语表示担忧，这给监控和监督带来了麻烦。新的研究发现，人工智能模型已经开始用一种奇怪的新英语版本进行交流，这种英语读起来像是詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《芬尼根守灵夜》和科技兄弟行话的混合体。自主人工智能代理正在迅速创造新的方言，使他们能够用一种通常难以理解的语言进行交谈，这可能会让人类更难监控他们的行为。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of AI communication, creating 'surreal' dialects, highlights a growing gap between human understanding and machine intelligence. As knowledge and complexity increase, as described in Daniel 12:4, we are called to seek wisdom and discernment to navigate these new frontiers, ensuring our oversight remains effective.
reflection.zh: 人工智能交流的快速发展，创造出“超现实”的方言，凸显了人类理解与机器智能之间日益扩大的差距。正如但以理书12:4所述，随着知识和复杂性的增加，我们被呼召寻求智慧和分辨力，以驾驭这些新领域，确保我们的监督保持有效。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: US confirms for first time it has deployed weapons in space
title.zh: 美国首次确认已部署太空武器

summary.en: The US military has confirmed the deployment of weapons in space, a move that analysts warn could escalate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth's orbit. The confirmation comes from the US Air Force Secretary, who stated that "on-orbit" weapons are now active and circling the globe.
summary.zh: 美国军方已确认在太空部署了武器，分析人士警告此举可能加剧与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长证实了这一消息，并表示“在轨”武器已处于活动状态并绕地球运行。

body.en: Analysts warn of an acceleration in high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit The US has deployed weapons in space, the US military has confirmed, in an extraordinary public announcement that analysts warn will accelerate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit. The US secretary of the air force, Troy Meink, said Washington had active “on-orbit” weapons, meaning they had been deployed and were circling the globe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 分析人士警告称，与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛将加速美国军方在一份非同寻常的公开声明中证实，美国已在太空部署武器，分析人士警告称，这将加速与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长特洛伊·梅因克表示，华盛顿拥有活跃的“在轨”武器，这意味着它们已经部署并正在环绕地球飞行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The confirmation of weapons in space is a sobering development, highlighting humanity's persistent drive to weaponize new frontiers. Isaiah's vision of a world where nations 'beat their swords into plowshares' offers a stark contrast to this trajectory. May we pray for wisdom and restraint among global powers, that the pursuit of security does not lead to...
reflection.zh: 在太空部署武器的确认是一个令人警醒的发展，凸显了人类将新领域武器化的持续驱动力。以赛亚关于世界各国“将刀打成犁头”的异象与这一轨迹形成了鲜明对比。愿我们为全球大国祈求智慧和克制，使对安全的追求不至于导致相互毁灭。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: US allies in Asia alarmed as think tank calls for pullback
title.zh: 亚洲盟友对智库呼吁撤军感到震惊

summary.en: Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position. A report by Jennifer Kavanagh of the Defense Priorities Foundation advocates for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense...
summary.zh: 分析人士警告称，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。珍妮弗·卡瓦纳（Jennifer Kavanagh）在偏右的国防优先基金会（Defense Priorities...

body.en:
Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

A study by a US foreign policy think tank advocates a major military pullback from the western Pacific, prompting concern among long-standing allies of the United States across the Indo-Pacific, analysts say.

The report  was authored by Jennifer Kavanagh, a senior fellow and director of military analysis at the right-of-center Defense Priorities Foundation. Kavanagh calls for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense alliances with South Korea , Japan , Australia and the Philippines .

The priority for Washington, she states, is to defend the US homeland and safeguard access to key economic markets and trade routes. That would be best served by pulling back from the "first island chain," which runs from Okinawa in southern Japan, through Taiwan and on to the Philippines.

Kavanagh writes that US forces should be pared back and moved to the "second island chain," which runs from eastern Japan to the Northern Marianas Islands in the central Pacific, Guam, Palau and on to Papua New Guinea.

The report states that moving the troops back would make their positions easier to defend and "reduce the risk of a catastrophic war with China."

Such a withdrawal would arguably be most keenly felt in Taiwan , which Beijing views as a renegade province that must one day be assimilated into greater China .

In her report, Kavanagh notes that the US has no formal commitment to come to the assistance of Taiwan in the event of an attack by China. She warns that any armed clash "would come at an exorbitant cost for the United States, far in excess of any benefits."

"With a cost-benefit calculation this lopsided, a change in the US commitment to Taiwan seems wise," she said. "The United States should shift from strategic ambiguity to a clear non-intervention policy in the event of any military confrontation over Taiwan."

The countries named in the report have made no formal comments on the think tank's proposals, but its conclusions "will be viewed with shock," William Yang, a Taiwan-based security analyst for the International Crisis Group, told DW.

The concern will be even deeper given that the Defense Priorities Foundation is known for its isolationist foreign and defense policy positions and is reputed to have ties with a number of senior and like-minded decision-makers in the White House, Yang said.

Yang noted that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened to withdraw troops from allied nations in Europe and Asia if his demands for larger payments or concessions in some other area of the bilateral relationship were not met, Yang...
body.zh: 分析人士警告说，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。 分析人士称，美国外交政策智囊团的一项研究主张从西太平洋地区大规模撤军，这引起了美国在印太地区的长期盟友的担忧。 该报告的作者詹妮弗·卡瓦纳 (Jennifer Kavanagh) 是中右翼国防优先基金会的高级研究员兼军事分析主任。卡瓦纳呼吁美国终止与韩国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾的共同防御联盟，“缩小其在该地区的防务承诺”。 她表示，华盛顿的首要任务是保卫美国本土并保障进入主要经济市场和贸易路线的机会。最好的办法是从“第一岛链”撤军，该岛链从日本南部的冲绳岛，穿过台湾，一直延伸到菲律宾。 卡瓦纳写道，美军应该削减规模，并转移到“第二岛链”，该岛链从日本东部到太平洋中部的北马里亚纳群岛、关岛、帕劳，再到巴布亚新几内亚。 报告指出，撤军将使他们的阵地更容易保卫，并“减少与中国发生灾难性战争的风险”。 可以说，这种撤军对台湾的感受最为强烈，北京将台湾视为一个叛逆的省份，有一天必须被纳入大中华区。 卡瓦纳在报告中指出，美国没有正式承诺在台湾遭受中国袭击时向台湾提供援助。她警告说，任何武装冲突“都会给美国带来高昂的代价，远远超过任何好处”。 她说：“鉴于成本效益计算如此不平衡，美国改变对台湾的承诺似乎是明智的。” “如果台湾问题发生任何军事对抗，美国应该从战略模糊转向明确的不干预政策。” 国际危机组织驻台湾安全分析师杨威廉告诉德国之声，报告中点名的国家尚未对该智库的提议发表正式评论，但其结论“将会令人震惊”。 杨说，鉴于国防优先基金会以其孤立主义外交和国防政策立场而闻名，并且据称与白宫许多高级和志同道合的决策者有联系，这种担忧将会更加严重。 杨指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁称，如果他在双边关系其他领域提出的更多付款或让步的要求得不到满足，他将从欧洲和亚洲盟国撤军。

reflection.en: A report from the Defense Priorities Foundation suggests a significant shift in US defense strategy, advocating for a pullback from the western Pacific and the termination of key alliances. This proposal, intended to re-evaluate commitments, has understandably alarmed long-standing allies who rely on these security arrangements. The situation underscores...
reflection.zh: 国防优先基金会的一份报告建议美国国防战略发生重大转变，主张从西太平洋撤军并终止关键联盟。这项旨在重新评估承诺的提议，可以理解地引起了那些依赖这些安全安排的长期盟友的警惕。这一局势凸显了在考虑影响全球稳定和信任的重大政策变革时，审慎权衡和明智咨询的至关重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: ‘This is seriously bold’: How China turned Taiwan tensions into a top-rating TV spy drama
title.zh: “这真是大胆”：中国如何将台湾紧张局势变成一部收视率飙升的电视间谍剧

summary.en: A new Chinese spy drama, 'Long Watch' (Jiaofeng), co-produced by the Ministry of State Security, has become a hit across the Taiwan Strait. The show, which fictionalizes real-life crises, follows a double agent working for China whose cover is blown. While dismissed as propaganda in Taiwan, the series' success...
summary.zh: 一部由国家安全部联合制作的中国新间谍剧《交锋》（Jiaofeng）已成为海峡两岸的热门剧集。该剧将现实生活中的危机虚构化，讲述了一名在中国大陆秘密工作的双面间谍被揭穿的故事。尽管在台湾被斥为宣传片，但该剧的成功凸显了娱乐媒体在处理敏感政治话题方面的作用。

body.en: Dismissed in Taiwan as simply propaganda, the Long Watch, or Jiaofeng, has proved a sensation across the strait with its references to real-life crises After shaking off the people trailing her through a crowded market and emerging from a bathroom in disguise, the double agent appears to have escaped. But a sip of water on a plane eventually gets her. She is poisoned after Taiwan’s military intelligence service discovers that she has been working secretly for China. The plot comes from a new Chinese spy drama co-produced by the Ministry of State Security. Since its premiere on 6 September, it has become a TV hit, with a fictionalised take on a subject rarely treated so directly: the modern history of tensions with Taiwan. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在台湾，《长守》或《叫风》被认为只是宣传品，但它却因提及现实生活中的危机而轰动了海峡两岸。在摆脱了跟踪她的人穿过拥挤的市场，乔装打扮地从浴室里出来后，这位双重间谍似乎已经逃脱了。但飞机上的一小口水最终让她崩溃了。台湾军事情报部门发现她一直在为中国大陆秘密工作后，她被毒死。剧情来自于国家安全部联合制作的一部新的中国谍战剧。自 9 月 6 日首播以来，它已成为电视热门节目，以虚构的方式讲述了一个很少如此直接处理的主题：与台湾紧张关系的现代历史。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This drama, 'Long Watch,' produced with the involvement of China's Ministry of State Security, uses fictionalized events to explore cross-strait tensions. It raises questions about how narratives are shaped and disseminated through popular media, reminding us of the importance of discerning truth from fiction, as Ephesians 4:25 urges us to speak truthfully...
reflection.zh: 这部由中国国家安全部参与制作的《交锋》剧集，通过虚构的情节来探讨海峡两岸的紧张局势。它引发了关于叙事如何通过大众媒体塑造和传播的疑问，提醒我们要分辨真伪，正如以弗所书4章25节所劝勉的，要说诚实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: China dismisses AI ‘fearmongering’ as spy chief warns of threat to Communist party rule
title.zh: 中国驳斥人工智能‘危言耸听’，情报主管警告其威胁执政党统治

summary.en: China has rejected concerns about its AI industry, dismissing calls for the US to impede its progress as 'fearmongering.' This comes as China's top spy chief warned that artificial intelligence could pose a threat to the ruling Communist Party's authority.
summary.zh: 中国驳斥了对其人工智能产业的担忧，称阻止其发展的呼吁是“危言耸听”。与此同时，中国最高情报主管警告称，人工智能可能威胁到执政的共产党当局的统治。

body.en: Beijing hits back after Anthropic CEO calls for US to impede China’s progress in AI China has dismissed what it said were “fearmongering” calls for the US to block Beijing’s AI industry, even as the top Chinese spy chief warned the evolving technology could threaten Communist party rule. The US tech entrepreneur and Anthropic chief executive, Dario Amodei, wrote an essay published over the weekend that called for a global slowdown in AI capabilities, but also said Washington should actively impede Beijing’s advancement in order to keep a technological edge. Continue reading...
body.zh: Anthropic首席执行官呼吁美国阻止中国在人工智能领域取得进展，北京对此进行了反击。尽管中国最高间谍头子警告说，不断发展的技术可能会威胁共产党的统治，但中国驳回了所谓美国封锁北京人工智能产业的“恐吓”呼吁。美国科技企业家兼 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在周末发表了一篇文章，呼吁全球人工智能能力放缓，但也表示华盛顿应积极阻碍北京的进步，以保持技术优势。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in China's push for progress, echoes the ancient story of Babel. Humanity's ambition to reach new heights, whether through technology or architecture, can lead to unforeseen consequences and challenges to established order. We are called to pursue knowledge and innovation with humility and wisdom,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如中国在这一领域所展现的进步一样，令人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。人类追求更高成就的野心，无论是通过技术还是建筑，都可能带来意想不到的后果，并对既有秩序构成挑战。我们蒙召要以谦卑和智慧追求知识与创新，认识到自身的局限，并努力建设而非过度扩张。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: 'Deeply offensive' to suggest farmers 'prefer to abuse and exploit backpackers', NFF says
title.zh: “暗示农民‘宁愿虐待和剥削背包客’是‘极其冒犯的’”，全国农民联合会表示

summary.en: Australia's peak farming body has strongly criticized Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke's remarks, which suggested farmers might prefer to exploit 'backpackers' rather than utilize the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme. The National Farmers' Federation (NFF) warned that proposed changes to backpacker...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的最高农业机构强烈批评了内政部长托尼·伯克的言论，他暗示农民可能宁愿剥削“背包客”，而不是利用太平洋澳大利亚劳务流动（PALM）计划。全国农民联合会（NFF）警告说，拟议的背包客签证变更可能会影响农业劳动力，并可能导致食品价格上涨。

body.en:
Australia's peak farming body has accused Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke of making "deeply offensive" comments about farmers, as concern grows over how changes to backpacker visas could affect the nation's agricultural workforce.

The National Farmers' Federation (NFF) has warned the changes could contribute to higher food prices if they leave growers without enough workers during key harvest periods — times when farmers often hire 'backpackers' on Working Holiday visas.

While Burke acknowledged the migration changes would create challenges for some, he suggested the agricultural sector could utilise additional capacity in the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme.

The scheme allows eligible Australian businesses to recruit workers from nine Pacific island countries and Timor-Leste when there are not enough local workers available.

Burke also said the strengthening of protections for PALM workers during his tenure as employment minister had led to warnings from some agricultural employers that they would turn away from the PALM scheme.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"At the time that we were improving those rules, we had some of the farm organisations say to us, 'If you do this, our members will just go and use backpackers,'" Burke told SBS News.

"If the reason that people are more reliant on backpackers and refusing to use Pacific workers is because they're upset that we've ended exploitation in those areas, I think that is a very different question for a number of operators."

He also stressed the criticism did not apply to the entire agricultural sector, saying "that doesn't depict the whole of the farm sector, not for a minute".

Richard Shannon, executive officer of the NFF Horticulture Council, labelled Burke's comments as "provocative" and rejected any suggestion that employers had moved away from the PALM scheme because of stronger protections for workers.

"The minister is suggesting that employers in horticulture would prefer to abuse and exploit backpackers than remain in the PALM program," Shannon told SBS News.

"This is not about exploiting people and finding loopholes, and it's deeply offensive."

Shannon argued that the reason some employers had moved away from PALM was because changes to the scheme had increased costs and administrative requirements.

He said backpackers and PALM workers also served different purposes within the agricultural workforce and could not simply be substituted for one another.

Employers in the PALM scheme have responsibilities including arranging accommodation and transport and providing additional support to workers.

Shannon said those requirements made the scheme...
body.zh: 澳大利亚农业最高机构指责内政部长托尼·伯克对农民发表“非常无礼”的言论，因为人们越来越担心背包客签证的变化可能会影响该国的农业劳动力。 全国农民联合会（NFF）警告称，如果这些变化导致种植者在关键收获期（农民经常雇用持有工作假期签证的“背包客”）没有足够的工人，可能会导致粮食价格上涨。 虽然伯克承认移民变化会给一些人带来挑战，但他建议农业部门可以利用太平洋澳大利亚劳动力流动（PALM）计划中的额外产能。 当当地工人不足时，该计划允许符合条件的澳大利亚企业从九个太平洋岛国和东帝汶招聘工人。 伯克还表示，在他担任就业部长期间加强了对 PALM 工人的保护，导致一些农业雇主警告他们将放弃 PALM 计划。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “当我们改进这些规则时，一些农场组织对我们说，‘如果你这样做，我们的成员就会去使用背包客，’”伯克告诉 SBS 新闻。 “如果人们更加依赖背包客并拒绝使用太平洋工人的原因是因为他们对我们结束在这些地区的剥削感到不安，我认为这对许多经营者来说是一个非常不同的问题。” 他还强调，批评并不适用于整个农业部门，并表示“这并没有描述整个农业部门，一分钟都没有”。 NFF 园艺委员会执行官理查德·香农 (Richard Shannon) 将伯克的言论称为“挑衅性”，并拒绝任何有关雇主因对工人提供更强有力的保护而放弃 PALM 计划的说法。 香农告诉 SBS 新闻：“部长建议园艺雇主宁愿虐待和剥削背包客，也不愿留在 PALM 计划中。” “这不是剥削人民、寻找漏洞，这是非常令人反感的。” Shannon 认为，一些雇主放弃 PALM 的原因是该计划的变更增加了成本和管理要求。 他说，背包客和 PALM 工人在农业劳动力中也有不同的用途，不能简单地相互替代。 PALM 计划中的雇主有责任安排住宿和交通以及为工人提供额外支持。 香农说，这些要求使得该计划......

reflection.en: When public officials make statements that deeply offend and misrepresent a sector, it raises questions about how we speak about and treat those who provide essential services. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. This means engaging with all parties, including farmers and workers, with respect and a commitment to...
reflection.zh: 当公众人物发表冒犯性言论并歪曲某个行业时，这引发了我们如何谈论和对待提供基本服务者的疑问。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，并与我们的神同行。这意味着要以尊重和公平的态度与各方打交道，包括农民和工人，而不是诉诸制造分裂的指控。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Shark catch-and-kill order issued after swimmer dies off popular Perth beach
title.zh: 珀斯海滩附近鲨鱼袭击事件导致游泳者死亡

summary.en: A 63-year-old man has died after being bitten by a shark while swimming off Sorrento beach in Perth, Western Australia. Emergency services responded to the incident on Friday morning. The beach has been closed and authorities are urging the public to stay out of the water.
summary.zh: 一名63岁男子在西澳大利亚州珀斯索伦托海滩游泳时遭鲨鱼袭击身亡。紧急服务部门于周五上午接到报案并赶赴现场。该海滩已被关闭，当局敦促公众远离海水。

body.en: Man, 63, fatally bitten by shark at Sorrento beach on Friday morning Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A shark that fatally attacked a man on a beach in Perth’s north will be “destroyed” if it is captured, after an order was issued by the Western Australian government. As the hunt for the animal remained under way on Saturday, the WA fisheries minister, Jackie Jarvis, revealed she had greenlit the order. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一名 63 岁男子在珀斯北部索伦托海滩附近被鲨鱼咬伤后死亡。 周五上午 10 点 30 分左右，接到与鲨鱼相关的事件报告后，紧急服务人员接到通知前往这片颇受欢迎的海滩。 西澳大利亚警方表示，一名男子在海岸游泳时被鲨鱼咬伤。警方称，他因伤势过重而死亡。 包括水利和航空人员在内的紧急服务人员对该地区进行了广泛的搜索。游泳者的尸体尚未找到。 阿尔基莫斯冲浪救生俱乐部表示，索伦托海滩将关闭至周六中午。当地人被敦促不要下水，直到海滩被宣布可以安全游泳为止。 旺纳罗市关闭了其海岸线沿线的所​​有其他海滩，直到周六中午。 周六早上，西澳警方继续在海岸线搜寻，但表示仍未找到这名 63 岁的男子。 当地州议员利亚姆·斯塔塔里 (Liam Staltari) 向该男子的家人、朋友和亲人表示哀悼。 他说：“像所有当地人和西澳各地的人们一样，我对今天在索伦托海滩发生鲨鱼袭击事件后一名男子的悲惨死亡深感悲痛。” 目击者达雷尔·海索恩斯韦特 (Darrel Haythornthwaite) 告诉第七台新闻，他不敢相信这起事件发生了，“尤其是在这样的地方”。他说，与他一起游泳的该男子的朋友虽然回到了岸边，但仍无法安慰。 “他感觉很糟糕，因为他没有回去救他的伴侣，我说，‘不，你不能这么做’，”他告诉媒体。 “没有任何人能做到的事情。” 另一位目击者英格丽德·米切尔告诉九号台新闻，她每天都在海滩游泳，没想到鲨鱼会在黎明和黄昏之外袭击。 “那里还有其他游泳者……就在海藻附近，还有一个可怜的女孩在那里晒太阳，她也看到了这一切，”她说。 第三位目击者雅基·拉帕伊克 (Jacqui Rapaic) 告诉美国广播公司，事件发生时她正在和一位朋友沿着海滩散步。 “我的朋友说，‘杰克，我认为发生了鲨鱼袭击事件’，我向大海望去，看到了一滩血，”她说。 “我拥抱了我的朋友……当时我们感到相当受创伤。事情发生得太快了。” 周一，西澳中西海岸杰拉尔顿以北偏远的格伦菲尔德海滩发生鲨鱼袭击事件，导致一名冲浪者受重伤。 他被送往附近的杰拉尔顿卫生院，目前情况稳定。

reflection.en: The suddenness of death, especially in a place of recreation like Sorrento beach, can leave survivors reeling with shock and grief. In moments of profound loss, the biblical vision of a world free from death and sorrow offers a glimpse of ultimate hope and healing. It points to a future where suffering is no more, and peace finally reigns.
reflection.zh: 死亡的突然降临，尤其是在索伦托海滩这样的休闲场所，会给幸存者带来巨大的震惊和悲痛。在遭受巨大损失的时刻，圣经中关于一个没有死亡和悲伤的世界的异象，提供了终极希望和医治的曙光。它指向一个痛苦将不复存在、和平最终掌权的未来。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

reflection.zh: 这项旨在以狭隘的“国家自豪感”取代原住民历史和文化教育的提议，引发了关于什么才能真正建立强大国家的疑问。《箴言》14:34指出，是公义使邦国高升，而非仅仅是选择性的历史叙述。一个拥抱国家完整、复杂故事（包括其原住民遗产）的课程，或许能培养出更强大、更具包容性的国家认同感。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.

title.en: The world is arguing about migration. Here's where Australia fits
title.zh: 世界在争论移民问题。澳大利亚的立场是怎样的

summary.en: Australia is tightening its migration system. Here's how its crackdown compares with changes unfolding around the world.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚正在收紧其移民体系。以下是其打击措施与世界各地正在发生的变革的比较。

body.en:
Australia has unveiled a major shake-up of its migration system, targeting visa-hoppers, overstayers, international students and backpackers as the federal government seeks to bring migration down further.

The changes come as governments in several other major migrant destinations — including Canada, the United Kingdom, the United States and Europe — also tighten parts of their immigration systems.

Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke announced the reforms on Thursday, which include restrictions on international students bringing family members, new rules aimed at preventing "visa hopping", and caps on working holidaymakers seeking to extend their stays.

The government is also strengthening enforcement against visa overstayers and migration agents who lodge applications without merit, while changing the skilled migration system to prioritise workers in areas including healthcare, construction and education.

The government wants to bring net overseas migration down from 292,100 to 245,000 in the year to July 2027, and to 225,000 each year thereafter.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The changes include caps on working holidaymakers extending their stays, with 45,000 second-year places and just 5,000 third-year places — down from 57,000 and 31,000 respectively.

There will also be a crackdown on the 77,000 people who are believed to be overstaying their visas: they will face tougher enforcement, including detention.

So, how does Australia's approach compare with migration changes elsewhere in the world?

The United States has pursued what US President Donald Trump has promised to be the "largest domestic deportation" operation in US history, built on aggressive enforcement.

Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has been tasked with that crackdown after its annual budget more than tripled, with heavily armed agents facing worldwide backlash for aggressive tactics, including the fatal shootings of two US citizens this year in Minneapolis.

The Department of Homeland Security says the Trump administration has deported more than 605,000 "illegal aliens", with a further 1.9 million "self-deporting".

Trump has also focused on border security, particularly in the south, primarily targeting Mexican migrants and those crossing the border illegally — as well as the construction of the continued and expanded construction of the Mexico-United States border wall.

He has also worked to restrict the entry of foreigners who do follow the rules and has gone after those who overstay their visas after they expire.

The US government plans to revoke the visas of foreigners who came to the country for tourism or business but sought...
body.zh: 随着联邦政府寻求进一步减少移民，澳大利亚公布了对其移民制度的重大调整，针对签证跳跃者、逾期居留者、国际学生和背包客。 这些变化发生之际，其他几个主要移民目的地——包括加拿大、英国、美国和欧洲——的政府也收紧了部分移民制度。 内政部长托尼·伯克周四宣布了改革，其中包括限制国际学生携带家庭成员、旨在防止“签证跳变”的新规定，以及对寻求延长逗留期限的打工度假者设置上限。 政府还在加强对签证逾期居留者和无正当理由提出申请的移民代理的执法力度，同时改变技术移民制度，优先考虑医疗保健、建筑和教育等领域的工人。 政府希望在截至 2027 年 7 月的一年内将海外净移民人数从 292,100 人减少到 245,000 人，此后每年减少到 225,000 人。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这些变化包括打工度假者延长逗留时间的上限，第二年的名额为 45,000 个，第三年的名额仅为 5,000 个，分别低于 57,000 个和 31,000 个。 77,000名被认为逾期居留的人也将受到打击：他们将面临更严厉的执法，包括拘留。 那么，澳大利亚的做法与世界其他地方的移民变化相比如何呢？ 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普承诺，在积极执法的基础上，美国将实施美国历史上“最大规模的国内驱逐”行动。 移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 的年度预算增加了两倍多，全副武装的特工因咄咄逼人的策略而面临全世界的强烈反对，包括今年在明尼阿波利斯枪杀两名美国公民的事件，该局承担了这一打击行动的任务。 美国国土安全部表示，特朗普政府已驱逐了超过 605,000 名“非法外国人”，另有 190 万人“自我驱逐”。 特朗普还关注边境安全，特别是南部地区，主要针对墨西哥移民和非法越境者，以及继续和扩大墨西哥-美国边境墙的建设。 他还努力限制遵守规定的外国人入境，并追查签证过期后逾期居留的人。 美国政府计划吊销那些来美国旅游或经商但寻求...的外国人的签证。

reflection.en: As nations grapple with migration policies, the ancient call to welcome the stranger resonates. Deuteronomy 10:19 reminds us that Yahweh loves the foreigner, providing for them and loving them. This principle calls for compassion and justice in how societies treat those seeking a new home.
reflection.zh: 当各国都在努力制定移民政策时，古老的欢迎陌生人的呼召依然回响。申命记10:19提醒我们，雅伟爱寄居的，并且顾惜他，供给他。这一原则呼吁我们在社会对待那些寻求新家园的人时，要怀有怜悯和公义。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: How much the age pension is rising — and a hit to your next holiday

body.en:
You may be aware that interest rates are likely to rise again in Australia, but did you know they may increase twice this year?

Economists have been revising their forecasts this week as global central banks start lifting rates to counter stubborn inflation, but some relief may be on the way.

About 2.7 million people will see the increase from the upcoming round of indexation from 20 September.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

There will also be upward adjustments for those who receive the Disability Support Pension.

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) warned this week that airfares will continue to climb as oil prices bounce higher and the war in the Middle East drags on.

In its Domestic Airline Competition in Australia report, it also revealed just how concentrated the market is locally.

Qantas Group, which also owns Jetstar, dominates with a 65.2 per cent share, Virgin Australia 33.3 per cent and Rex just 1.5 per cent.

"We'll be watching closely," ACCC chair Gina Cass-Gotlieb told me on the SBS On the Money podcast .

"We want to make sure they keep independently setting prices and independently make commercial decisions despite these challenging conditions."

Cass-Gotlieb said that while airlines may navigate higher jet fuel prices by cutting capacity, which means fewer seats in the sky, relief might come in time as Sydney's second airport comes online.

"What Western Sydney (International) will introduce is more available slots for take-off and landings and that can assist with new entrant airlines which we are hoping to see."

The Western Sydney International Airport is scheduled to commence commercial passenger services in October.

Well, the reality is the Reserve Bank was already lifting official interest rates earlier this year before many other global central banks, because Australia was experiencing inflationary pressures before the war in the Middle East started.

But now, global central banks have started addressing price pressures relating to higher oil prices by lifting interest rates.

Last week, the Bank of Japan boosted rates to a 31-year high, while the US Federal Reserve also moved higher for the first time in more than three years.

So while Australian interest rates don't always move in tandem, economists say the world economy is now facing the same inflationary pressures.

Investment bank UBS became the latest to change its forecast and is now expecting two more RBA rate rises this year, taking the official cash rate to 4.8 per cent, with the first to come at the next meeting at the end of this month.

It blames three things: a change in tune from global central banks which are now lifting...
body.zh: 我知道您可能已经意识到澳大利亚的利率可能会再次上涨，但您知道今年可能会上涨两次吗？ 随着全球央行开始加息以应对顽固的通胀，经济学家本周一直在修改他们的预测，但一些缓解可能即将到来。 大约 270 万人将在 9 月 20 日开始的下一轮指数化中看到增量。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 对于那些领取残疾支持养老金的人来说，也将进行向上调整。 澳大利亚竞争与消费者委员会（ACCC）本周警告称，随着油价反弹以及中东战争的持续，机票价格将继续上涨。 在其澳大利亚国内航空公司竞争报告中，该公司还揭示了当地市场的集中程度。 捷星航空旗下的澳洲航空集团以 65.2% 的份额占据主导地位，维珍澳大利亚航空 (Virgin Australia) 占 33.3%，雷克斯航空 (Rex) 仅占 1.5%。 “我们将密切关注，”ACCC 主席 Gina Cass-Gotlieb 在 SBS On the Money 播客上告诉我。 “尽管面临这些充满挑战的条件，我们希望确保他们继续独立定价并独立做出商业决策。” 卡斯-戈特利布表示，虽然航空公司可能会通过削减运力来应对航空燃油价格上涨的问题，这意味着空中座位数会减少，但随着悉尼第二机场的投入使用，情况可能会及时缓解。 “西悉尼（国际）将推出更多可用的起飞和降落时刻，这可以为我们希望看到的新进入航空公司提供帮助。” 事实上，现实情况是，今年早些时候，澳大利亚储备银行已经先于许多其他全球央行提高了官方利率，因为澳大利亚在中东战争爆发之前就面临着通胀压力。 但现在，全球央行已开始通过提高利率来应对与油价上涨相关的价格压力。 上周，日本央行将利率提高至 31 年来的高点，而美联储也三年多来首次加息。 因此，尽管澳大利亚的利率并不总是同步变化，但经济学家表示，世界经济现在面临着同样的通胀压力。 投资银行瑞银(UBS)成为最新一家改变预测的银行，目前预计澳大利亚央行今年将加息两次，将官方现金利率提高至4.8%，第一次加息将在本月底的下一次会议上进行。 它归咎于三件事：全球央行的态度改变，现在正在加息；油价上涨源于...

reflection.en: As interest rates climb, the burden of debt grows heavier, echoing the ancient wisdom that the borrower becomes enslaved to the lender. For many pensioners, this rise in living costs, coupled with increased borrowing expenses, presents a significant challenge to their financial well-being. May we be mindful of those struggling under financial pressures, and...
reflection.zh: 随着利率的攀升，债务的负担越来越重，这呼应了古老的智慧：借贷者成为放贷者的奴隶。对于许多领取养老金的人来说，生活成本的上涨以及借贷费用的增加，给他们的财务状况带来了严峻的挑战。 愿我们体谅那些在财务压力下挣扎的人们，愿智慧指引经济政策，以保护弱势群体。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: Beaches closed after man dies in shark attack near Perth
title.zh: 珀斯附近发生鲨鱼袭击事件，一名男子死亡，海滩关闭

summary.en: Authorities have confirmed a male swimmer is dead after being attacked by a shark at Perth's Sorrento Beach. The incident led to the closure of local beaches.
summary.zh: 当局证实，一名男性游泳者在珀斯索伦托海滩遭到鲨鱼袭击后死亡。事件导致当地海滩关闭。

body.en:
A swimmer is dead after being attacked by a shark off a popular Western Australian beach.

Emergency services attended Perth's Sorrento Beach about 10.30am on Friday after reports a male had been bitten by a shark while swimming along the coast.

Authorities searched for the swimmer from the air and sea, but he died from the attack, with his remains found in the water, WA Police said.

The Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development is investigating the incident, the second shark attack off WA's coast in five days.

A witness told ABC News she was alerted to the attack when she was walking along the beach and saw a pool of blood in the water.

The City of Joondalup has closed all beaches in the area, from Burns Beach in the north to Marmion in the south, until midday on Saturday as a precaution.

The man was seriously injured at Glenfield Beach, north of Geraldton in the state's Mid West.

He was taken to the nearby Geraldton Health Campus and is now in a stable condition.

They will operate initially on weekends before increasing to a daily frequency between Mandurah and Yanchep, and Rottnest Island to the west, from 26 September until the end of April.

Patrol flights in WA's southwest between Bunbury and Hamelin Bay will run daily during school holidays and peak summer periods, and on weekends and public holidays at other times.

body.zh: 一名游泳者在西澳大利亚一个受欢迎的海滩上被鲨鱼袭击后死亡。 周五上午 10 点 30 分左右，紧急服务人员赶到了珀斯的索伦托海滩，此前有报道称，一名男子在海岸游泳时被鲨鱼咬伤。 西澳警方表示，当局从空中和海上搜寻了这名游泳者，但他在袭击中死亡，他的遗体在水中被发现。 第一产业和区域发展部正在调查这起事件，这是西澳海岸五天内发生的第二起鲨鱼袭击事件。 一名目击者告诉美国广播公司新闻，当她沿着海滩散步并看到水中有一滩血时，她意识到了袭击事件。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 作为预防措施，君达乐市已关闭该地区的所有海滩，从北部的伯恩斯海滩到南部的马米恩，直至周六中午。 该男子在该州中西部杰拉尔顿以北的格伦菲尔德海滩受重伤。 他被送往附近的杰拉尔顿健康校区，目前情况稳定。 这些航班最初将在周末运营，然后从 9 月 26 日至 4 月底，增加至曼哲拉 (Mandurah) 和扬切普 (Yanchep) 以及西部罗特内斯特岛 (Rottnest Island) 之间的每日班次。 西澳西南部班伯里和哈梅林湾之间的巡逻航班将在学校假期和夏季高峰期以及周末和公共假期期间每天运行。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The suddenness of death, even in a place of leisure like Sorrento Beach, can be a stark reminder of life's fragility. We mourn with those who grieve this loss, holding onto the hope that Yahweh promises a future where death and suffering will cease entirely.
reflection.zh: 死亡的突然降临，即使是在索伦托海滩这样的休闲场所，也可能成为生命脆弱性的一个严峻提醒。我们与那些为此悲伤的人一同哀悼，并坚守雅伟所应许的未来——一个死亡和痛苦将完全消失的未来。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.

title.en: Nearly two million Quest Apartment Hotels customers affected by data breach
title.zh: 近两百万Quest Apartment Hotels客户受数据泄露事件影响

summary.en: Nearly two million Quest Apartment Hotels customers have had their personal information compromised in a data breach, with experts questioning the length of time companies retain such data.
summary.zh: 近两百万Quest Apartment Hotels客户的个人信息在一场数据泄露事件中遭到泄露，专家们质疑公司保留此类数据的时长。

body.en:
Personal information of nearly two million Quest Apartment Hotels customers has been compromised in a data breach, including credit card, passport and Medicare numbers.

Last month, the accommodation provider identified a cyberattack on a database system via a vulnerability in a third-party technology provider.

David Mansfield, the managing director of The Ascott Limited, which owns Quest Apartment Hotels, provided an update this week, saying a forensic data analysis revealed information relating to approximately 1,991,613 customers was affected.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Mansfield said the company was contacting those affected directly to inform them of which category they were in, the steps they could take, and available support.

"I recognise the concern this incident has caused. On behalf of Quest, I sincerely apologise to those who have been affected," he said.

Quest said it first identified an outage on its website on 17 August, with investigation revealing "a malicious attack" had exploited a vulnerability in a third-party service provider's software.

The company is advising customers to remain alert for suspicious emails, text messages and telephone calls, particularly communications requesting personal, financial or account information.

Quest said it was cooperating with the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner, the Australian Signals Directorate, the Australian Cyber Security Centre and Victoria Police.

Last year's Annual Cyber Threat Report warned cyberattacks were a growing problem in Australia, with financial losses, ransomware attack frequency, and the number of reported data breaches all increasing.

After a major data breach involving millions of Optus customers in 2022 , the federal government overhauled privacy laws, requiring companies to destroy or actively de-identify personal information as soon as it was no longer needed.

Paul Watters, chief executive of Cyberstronomy, which provides cyber risk expertise, said all businesses needed to have a clear understanding of the personal data they hold and why.

"Quest says all of the affected information came from records dating from before June 2025. That immediately raises a governance question: for each category of information, why was it still being retained?"

"Audit your data holdings. Know what you have, where it is, why you are retaining it, how long you need it, and when it should be deleted or de-identified. Data you no longer hold cannot be stolen in a breach," he said.

Belinda Barnet, a Swinburne University data privacy expert, told SBS News the latest incident raised concerns about the type of data some companies were still...
body.zh: 近 200 万 Quest Apartment Hotels 客户的个人信息在数据泄露中遭到泄露，其中包括信用卡、护照和医疗保险号码。 上个月，住宿提供商发现通过第三方技术提供商的漏洞对数据库系统进行了网络攻击。 Quest Apartment Hotels 旗下的雅诗阁有限公司 (The Ascott Limited) 董事总经理戴维·曼斯菲尔德 (David Mansfield) 本周提供了最新情况，称法证数据分析显示，与大约 1,991,613 名客户相关的信息受到了影响。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 曼斯菲尔德表示，该公司正在直接联系那些受影响的人，告知他们属于哪一类、可以采取的步骤以及可以获得的支持。 “我认识到这一事件引起的关注。我代表 Quest 向那些受到影响的人真诚地道歉，”他说。 Quest 表示，它于 8 月 17 日首次发现其网站出现故障，调查显示“恶意攻击”利用了第三方服务提供商软件中的漏洞。 该公司建议客户对可疑电子邮件、短信和电话保持警惕，特别是要求个人、财务或帐户信息的通信。 Quest 表示正在与澳大利亚信息专员办公室、澳大利亚信号局、澳大利亚网络安全中心和维多利亚警方合作。 去年的年度网络威胁报告警告称，网络攻击在澳大利亚是一个日益严重的问题，经济损失、勒索软件攻击频率以及报告的数据泄露数量都在增加。 2022 年发生涉及数百万 Optus 客户的重大数据泄露事件后，联邦政府彻底修改了隐私法，要求公司在不再需要个人信息时立即销毁或主动去识别化。 提供网络风险专业知识的 Cyber​​stronomy 首席执行官保罗·沃特斯 (Paul Watters) 表示，所有企业都需要清楚地了解他们所持有的个人数据及其原因。 “Quest 表示，所有受影响的信息都来自 2025 年 6 月之前的记录。这立即引发了一个治理问题：对于每一类信息，为什么仍然保留它？” “审计你持有的数据。了解你拥有什么、它在哪里、为什么保留它、你需要它多长时间以及何时应该删除它或去识别化。你不再持有的数据不会在泄露中被窃取，”他说。 斯威本大学数据隐私专家贝琳达·巴尼特 (Belinda Barnet) 告诉 SBS 新闻，最新事件引发了人们对一些公司仍在保留的数据类型的担忧……

reflection.en: The compromise of sensitive data like credit card and passport numbers for nearly two million customers underscores the risks inherent in storing vast amounts of personal information. This incident serves as a stark reminder of the potential for misuse and the deep-seated human desire for wealth and control that can drive illicit activities.
reflection.zh: 近两百万客户的信用卡和护照号码等敏感数据遭到泄露，凸显了存储大量个人信息所固有的风险。此次事件警示我们，这些信息可能被滥用，也反映了人类对财富和控制的深层渴望可能驱动非法活动。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: ICE enforcement in Australia? Burke quizzed over US-style detention concerns
title.zh: 澳大利亚的移民执法？伯克被问及对美国式拘留的担忧

summary.en: Australia's Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has rejected claims that the country is adopting a US-style immigration enforcement model following backlash over new migration reforms. The reforms include tougher measures for visa overstayers, with plans to add detention beds and compliance officers.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚内政部长托尼·伯克否认了该国正在效仿美国式移民执法模式的说法，此前政府的移民改革引发了强烈反对。改革包括对签证逾期居留者采取更严厉的措施，并计划增加拘留床位和合规官员。

body.en:
Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has rejected suggestions that Australia is moving towards a United States-style immigration enforcement model following backlash over the government's migration reforms .

Burke announced the new policy settings on Thursday, with the most consequential changes targeting "visa-hoppers", overstayers, students and backpackers in a bid to bring down net overseas migration figures.

People who overstay their visas, a cohort of roughly 77,000 people, would face tougher enforcement measures under the government's plans, including the prospect of detention. To discourage overstaying, the government will add 250 beds and 100 compliance officers, restoring capacity Burke said existed before 2015.

Under the pre-2015 approach, Burke said overstayers were detained and generally organised their own flights home within a matter of weeks. "This is not the sort of operation that some people have seen on TV happening in other countries," he said in his address.

The announcement nonetheless drew comparisons to US President Donald Trump's hardline immigration crackdown, carried out by the Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agency since he took office last year.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The agency has taken an aggressive approach to enforcement, detention and deportation, triggering mass protests, legal challenges and fierce debate over the treatment of migrants.

He reiterated that the policy is simply a return to Australia's approach before 2015, when visa overstayers, such as students, were routinely contacted, encouraged to leave, and, if necessary, detained briefly before arranging their own departure.

He said the practice ended when detention centres became dominated by criminals, forcing resources to be redirected. Burke described the proposed expansion to 250 detention beds as a modest restoration of a system that had operated for years.

"Australia stopped doing it for the very simple reason that our detention centres filled up with criminals," he told SBS News.

"That's what happened, and there's no way — in a block that's got a whole lot of people who've done some horrific things and have come straight from prison — that I'm going to put an international student who's overstayed in the same place. I'm just not going to do that."

He said it meant that for the past 11 years, Australia had "stopped doing what is the normal thing to do", referring to the use of detention as a deterrent for people who remain in the country after their visas expire.

"It's a very modest program. It used to be 250 beds, it'll be 250 beds again. It's nothing other than something that used to happen all the time, and...
body.zh: 在政府移民改革遭到强烈反对后，内政部长托尼·伯克拒绝了有关澳大利亚正在转向美国式移民执法模式的说法。 伯克周四宣布了新的政策设置，其中最重要的变化针对“签证跳跃者”、逾期居留者、学生和背包客，以降低海外净移民人数。 根据政府的计划，逾期居留的人约有 77,000 人，将面临更严厉的执法措施，包括可能被拘留。为了防止逾期居留，政府将增加 250 个床位和 100 名合规官员，恢复伯克所说的 2015 年之前的能力。 伯克表示，根据 2015 年之前的做法，逾期居留者会被拘留，并且通常会在几周内自行安排航班回家。他在讲话中说：“这不是一些人在电视上看到的其他国家发生的那种行动。” 尽管如此，这一声明还是与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)去年上任以来移民和海关执法局(ICE)实施的强硬移民镇压相提并论。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该机构在执法、拘留和驱逐方面采取了激进的做法，引发了大规模抗议、法律挑战以及关于移民待遇的激烈辩论。 他重申，这项政策只是回到了2015年之前澳大利亚的做法，当时，签证逾期居留者（例如学生）会被例行联系，鼓励他们离开，如果有必要，在安排他们自己离开之前会被短暂拘留。 他说，当拘留中心被犯罪分子控制时，这种做法就结束了，迫使资源重新分配。伯克称，拟议将拘留床位扩建至 250 个，是对已运行多年的系统的一次适度修复。 “澳大利亚停止这样做的原因很简单，因为我们的拘留中心挤满了罪犯，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “事情就是这样发生的，在一个有很多人做过一些可怕的事情并且刚从监狱出来的街区里，我不可能把一个逾期居留的国际学生放在同一个地方。我只是不会这样做。” 他说，这意味着在过去11年里，澳大利亚“不再做正常的事情”，指的是利用拘留作为对签证到期后留在澳大利亚的人的威慑。 “这是一个非常温和的计划。以前有 250 个床位，将来还会有 250 个床位。这只不过是过去经常发生的事情，而且......

reflection.en: The Australian government is implementing stricter measures for visa overstayers, including potential detention. This raises questions about how nations balance border security with humane treatment. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to 'do justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence.' May leaders always seek to...

title.en: HK hopes to ace next level with Victoria Park revamp
title.zh: 香港希望通过维多利亚公园改造迈向新台阶

summary.en: Hong Kong is considering a redevelopment plan for Victoria Park to transform its Centre Court and facilities into an all-weather, multi-purpose venue capable of hosting larger-scale tennis tournaments and other major sports and performance events. The government aims to attract significant events, boost the local...
summary.zh: 香港正考虑一项维多利亚公园的改造计划，旨在将其中央球场及相关设施改建为一个全天候、多功能的场地，能够举办更大规模的网球赛事及其他重大体育和表演活动。政府希望借此吸引大型活动，促进本地经济，并提升香港作为目的地的吸引力。

body.en: Hong Kong is exploring plans to turn Victoria Park into a venue capable of hosting larger-scale tennis tournaments under a redevelopment plan that the government says will attract major sports and entertainment events while boosting the local economy. According to the Policy Address delivered on Wednesday, authorities are exploring the redevelopment of Victoria Park Centre Court and other ancillary facilities into an all-weather, multi-purpose venue. It would be designed to host larger-scale, higher-level sports events as well as performance events when required. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said on Saturday Victoria Park’s central location and the positive response to last year’s National Games beach volleyball events held there made it a strong candidate. The success of Kai Tak Sports Park, she added, has shown what a well-connected urban venue can achieve. "We have several takeaways from the initial stages of Kai Tak Sports Park's opening," Law said. "First, Victoria Park is also a location in a relatively mature urban area with convenient transport. It turns out that the demand for sports facilities and the synergy are very strong. Major sporting events can also boost the local district's economy. Under this consideration, it made us feel that Victoria Park is actually a very suitable place." The government hopes the redeveloped Centre Court and ancillary facilities will be render the site suitable for staging at least ATP 500-level tennis events. Given sufficient resources, Law said, the venue could be expanded further to host larger events and even serve as a performance space. Under the initial plan, seating would rise to at least 7,000, with 10,000 seats possible if resources permit. "We have to at least host ATP 500 events, that is, ranking events with 500 points," Law said. "But I have an even greater expectation: if resources and the venue size permit, we may even be able to meet the ATP 1000 standard," she said. "This would be a very big boost for attracting visitors to Hong Kong and provide a good platform for our Hong Kong athletes to have a greater chance, as wild-card entrants, to compete in these top-level tennis events." Apart from tennis, Law said plans to make the venue an all-weather, multi-purpose facility could also mean it could host basketball, volleyball and other ball sports. Asked why the five-year plan set a 60 percent target for non-local performances at Kai Tak Sports Park, she said such shows currently accounted for about 40 to 50 percent. The 60 percent goal reflects the park’s suitability for world-tour-scale performances, she said, noting, however, that Hong Kong has other venues – such as the Hong Kong Coliseum – that can accommodate local performances. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 香港正在探索将维多利亚公园改造成一个能够举办更大规模网球比赛的场地的重建计划，政府称该计划将吸引大型体育和娱乐活动，同时促进当地经济。根据周三发表的施政报告，当局正探讨将维园中心法院及其他附属设施重建为全天候、多用途场地。它将被设计用于举办更大规模、更高水平的体育赛事以及必要时的表演赛事。文化体育及旅游局局长罗姗娜周六表示，维多利亚公园的中心位置以及去年全运会沙滩排球比赛的积极反响使其成为有力的候选地。她补充说，启德体育公园的成功展示了一个连接良好的城市场地可以取得的成就。罗说：“我们从启德体育园开业的初期阶段得到了一些收获。” “首先，维多利亚公园也是一个相对成熟的城区，交通便利，事实证明，对体育设施的需求和协同作用非常强，大型体育赛事也可以带动当地的经济。从这个角度考虑，让我们觉得维多利亚公园其实是一个非常合适的地方。”政府希望重新开发的中心球场和附属设施将使该场地适合举办至少ATP 500级别的网球赛事。劳表示，如果资源充足，该场馆可以进一步扩建，以举办更大的活动，甚至作为表演空间。根据最初的计划，座位数将增加到至少 7,000 个，如果资源允许的话，可能会增加到 10,000 个座位。 “我们至少要举办ATP 500赛事，即500分的排名赛，”劳说。 “但我有一个更大的期望：如果资源和场馆规模允许，我们甚至可以达到ATP 1000的标准，”她说。 “这将极大地促进吸引游客来香港，并为我们的香港运动员提供一个良好的平台，让他们以外卡选手的身份，有更大的机会参加这些顶级网球赛事。”劳表示，除了网球之外，将该场馆打造成全天候、多功能设施的计划还意味着它可以举办篮球、排球和其他球类运动。问及为何五年计划设定启德体育园外地演出占60%的目标，她表示，目前外地演出约占40%至50%。她表示，60%的目标反映了公园适合举办世界巡演规模的演出，不过她也指出，香港还有其他场馆，例如香港体育馆，可以举办本地演出。阿扎姆·汗编辑

reflection.en: Hong Kong's ambitious plan to upgrade Victoria Park reflects a desire for growth and economic vitality through hosting major events. Such endeavors, whether in sports or business, are opportunities to commit our work and plans to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for success and positive impact. May the city's efforts be blessed with wisdom and prosperity.
reflection.zh: 香港升级维多利亚公园的宏伟计划，体现了通过举办大型活动来追求增长和经济活力的愿望。无论是体育还是商业，此类事业都为我们提供了将工作和计划交托于雅伟、信靠祂的指引以求成功和积极影响的机会。愿这座城市的努力蒙受智慧和繁荣的祝福。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Hong Kong to open waters to Guangdong yachts under southbound scheme from October
title.zh: 香港10月起允许大湾区游艇通过南向计划进入其水域

summary.en: Hong Kong is set to launch a southbound scheme in October, enabling Guangdong-registered yachts to navigate its waters. This initiative, announced by the transport minister, is part of ongoing preparations and discussions with provincial authorities. The plan follows recent proposals in the city's policy address and...
summary.zh: 香港运输及物流局局长表示，一项允许广东注册游艇进入香港水域的南向计划预计将于10月启动。该计划是香港与广东省当局持续准备和讨论的一部分。此举是在本周公布的年度施政报告和香港首个五年规划中提出的发展游艇经济的建议之后。

body.en: A southbound scheme allowing Guangdong-registered yachts to sail in Hong Kong waters is expected to launch in October, the transport minister has said, with the city continuing preparations and discussions with provincial authorities. Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan revealed the plan on Saturday after the annual policy address and the city’s first five-year plan, both unveiled this week, set out proposals to develop the yacht economy. “The southbound travel scheme for yachts...
body.zh: 交通运输部部长表示，允许广东注册游艇在香港水域航行的南向计划预计将于十月启动，香港将继续与省政府进行准备和讨论。运输及物流局局长陈美洁于周六公布了该计划，此前年度施政报告和香港第一个五年计划均于本周公布，提出了发展游艇经济的建议。 “游艇南行旅游计划...

reflection.en: The launch of this new southbound yacht scheme represents a significant undertaking, requiring careful planning and execution. As this venture unfolds, may the leaders and authorities involved commit their efforts to Yahweh, seeking His guidance and blessing for its success and for the prosperity it aims to bring.
reflection.zh: 这项新的游艇南向计划的启动是一项重大的举措，需要周密的规划和执行。随着这项计划的展开，愿参与的领导者和当局将他们的努力托付给雅伟，寻求祂的指引和祝福，以期取得成功并带来预期的繁荣。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: City leader John Lee joins mourners at vigil for Tung Chee-hwa
title.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华逝世，李家超出席悼念仪式

summary.en: Hong Kong is mourning the passing of its first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, who died at age 89 on September 8. A weekend vigil saw tributes from political and business leaders, as well as the public. Tung led the city through significant events including the 1997 Asian financial crisis and the 2003 SARS outbreak.
summary.zh: 香港正在哀悼其首任行政长官董建华的逝世，他于9月8日去世，享年89岁。周末举行的悼念仪式上，政商界领袖及公众纷纷致以哀悼。董建华曾带领香港经历1997年亚洲金融危机和2003年非典疫情等重大事件。

body.en: Hong Kong is mourning the loss of its first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, in a weekend vigil, with tributes pouring in from political and business heavyweights as well as members of the public. Tung, who died at the age of 89 on September 8, led Hong Kong through ups and downs – the Asian financial crisis in 1997, the Sars outbreak in 2003 and a V-shaped rebound in the economy that followed. Saturday’s rituals, held at Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point, will be followed by a state funeral...
body.zh: 香港在周末守夜活动中哀悼首任特首董建华的去世，政界和商界重量级人物以及公众纷纷表达哀悼。 9月8日逝世，享年89岁的董建华带领香港经历了1997年亚洲金融危机、2003年非典爆发以及随后经济V型反弹。周六的仪式在北角香港殡仪馆举行，随后将举行国葬......

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing marks the end of a significant chapter for Hong Kong. His life, like all human lives, ultimately faced the universal reality of death. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is appointed for all, a solemn truth that invites reflection on the brevity and preciousness of life.
reflection.zh: 董建华逝世的消息标志着香港一个重要篇章的结束。他的生命，如同所有人类生命一样，最终面对着死亡这一普遍的现实。《希伯来书》9章27节提醒我们，人人都有一死，这是一个庄严的真理，促使我们反思生命的短暂与宝贵。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Hong Kong leader says firms must strive to survive despite government support
title.zh: 香港领导人表示，企业必须努力生存，即使有政府支持

summary.en: Hong Kong's leader has defended measures in his policy address to boost the economy and improve livelihoods, stressing that businesses must also do their part to remain competitive and survive, even with government aid. Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu said on Saturday that the livelihood section was the longest and...
summary.zh: 香港领导人已为其政策声明中旨在提振经济和改善民生的措施进行了辩护，强调企业即使在获得政府援助的情况下，也必须努力保持竞争力并生存下去。行政长官李家超周六表示，在被问及尚未从政府经济政策中受益的居民时，民生部分是他政策声明中篇幅最长、范围最广的部分。“你首先需要发展经济才能拥有……

body.en: Hong Kong’s leader has defended measures in his policy address to boost the economy and improve livelihoods, stressing that businesses must also do their part to remain competitive and survive, even with government aid. Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu said on Saturday that the livelihood section was the longest and broadest in scope in his policy address when asked about residents who had yet to benefit from the government’s economic policies. “You need to develop the economy first to have the...
body.zh: 香港领导人为其施政报告中提振经济和改善民生的措施进行了辩护，强调即使有政府援助，企业也必须尽自己的一份力量来保持竞争力和生存。行政长官李家超周六在被问及尚未受益于政府经济政策的居民时表示，民生部分是其施政报告中最长、范围最广泛的部分。 “你需要首先发展经济才能拥有......

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, the Chief Executive emphasizes that businesses must strive for self-sufficiency and competitiveness, even while receiving government support. This calls for a balance between aid and accountability, reminding us of the prophet Micah's timeless call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. True economic health requires not just...
reflection.zh: 在香港，行政长官强调，即使在获得政府支持的情况下，企业也必须努力实现自给自足和保持竞争力。这要求在援助和问责之间取得平衡，提醒我们先知弥迦那关于‘行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与雅伟同行’的永恒呼召。真正的经济健康不仅需要财政注入，还需要所有相关方的道德实践和负责任的管理。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Easier road, rail, yacht crossings set for Greater Bay
title.zh: 大湾区将迎来更便捷的陆路、铁路和游艇通关

summary.en: Hong Kong is advancing plans to enhance cross-boundary travel as part of a broader strategy to integrate the Greater Bay Area. Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan announced on Saturday that the government will continue to improve schemes for Hong Kong vehicles traveling north and Guangdong vehicles...
summary.zh: 香港正推进一系列跨境出行便利化措施，旨在深化大湾区一体化。运输及物流局局长陈帆周六表示，政府将继续优化“港车北上”和“ سعود车”计划，此举已纳入香港首个五年规划和施政报告。此外，海事处与广东省海上安全监督管理局将签署游艇出行计划的合作安排，预计十月将有关于游艇南下出行计划的好消息。

body.en: Hong Kong is pressing ahead with a series of cross-boundary travel improvements as part of a wider effort to deepen Greater Bay Area integration, said Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan on Saturday. She said the government would continue to enhance the Northbound Travel for Hong Kong Vehicles and Southbound Travel for Guangdong Vehicles schemes, as set out in Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the Policy Address. The Marine Department and the Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration, Chan also said, will soon sign off on two working arrangements on yacht travel schemes. "We expect that by October there should be good news about southbound travel for Guangdong yachts," she said. Chan added that the government was introducing changes and support measures to the schemes at the same time. "At the time when northbound travel for yachts from Hong Kong was launched, the Marine Department had already set up examination centres in Nansha so that captains from the mainland would not need to come to Hong Kong," she said. "They can take examinations on the mainland on knowledge of Hong Kong waters. Progress has been very good, and the response is good." Chan also outlined two additional measures: yachts would be allowed to use different anchorages in Hong Kong waters, and a dynamic system would be deployed to monitor them. The change would relax a current requirement that yachts use only fixed marina facilities, allowing them to use designated anchorages. On railway developments, Chan said the Northern Link and the Hung Shui Kiu-Qianhai section of the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link are expected to open in 2034 and 2035, respectively. A preliminary proposal on extending the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link southward is due next year. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 运输及物流局局长陈美宝周六表示，作为深化大湾区一体化更广泛努力的一部分，香港正在推进一系列跨境旅行改善措施。她表示，政府会按照香港第一个五年规划和《施政报告》的规定，继续完善港车北行和粤车南行计划。陈还表示，海事处和广东海事局将很快签署两项关于游艇旅行计划的工作安排。 “我们预计到十月份应该会有广东游艇南下旅游的好消息，”她说。陈补充说，政府正在同时对这些计划进行改革和支持措施。她说：“香港游艇北行推出时，海事处已在南沙设立考试中心，内地船长无需来港。” “他们可以在内地参加有关香港水域知识的考试。进展非常好，反响也很好。”陈还概述了两项额外措施：允许游艇在香港水域使用不同的锚地，并部署动态系统来监控它们。这一变化将放宽目前游艇仅使用固定码头设施的要求，允许它们使用指定的锚地。在铁路发展方面，陈肇始表示，港深西铁北环线和洪水桥至前海段预计分别于2034年和2035年通车。港深西铁线向南延伸的初步建议将于明年提交。罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: The government of Hong Kong is actively working to improve connectivity and integration within the Greater Bay Area. These efforts in planning and implementation, from vehicle schemes to yacht travel, reflect a commitment to progress and development. May their endeavors be guided by wisdom and lead to fruitful outcomes, remembering that true success is...
reflection.zh: 香港政府正积极推动改善大湾区内的连通性和一体化。从车辆计划到游艇出行，这些在规划和实施方面的努力都体现了对进步和发展的承诺。愿他们的努力得到智慧的指引并取得丰硕的成果，并铭记真正的成功在于将计划交托于雅伟。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Patriot dedicated to Hong Kong: business heavyweights remember Tung Chee-hwa
title.zh: 爱国者献身香港：商界巨头缅怀董建华

summary.en: Hong Kong is mourning the passing of its former chief executive and elder statesman, Tung Chee-hwa, who died on September 8 at the age of 89. A shipping tycoon, he was the city's first leader after the 1997 handover to China and is remembered for his dedicated stewardship and public service. A state funeral will be...
summary.zh: 香港正哀悼其前行政长官、资深政治家董建华的逝世，他于9月8日去世，享年89岁。这位航运巨头是1997年香港回归中国后的首任特首，以其尽心尽力的管治和公共服务而被铭记。届时将举行国葬以示哀荣。
