The shipping tycoon who became the city’s first leader after its transfer of sovereignty to China in 1997 died on September 8 at the age of 89, leaving a legacy of determined stewardship and dedicated public service. This weekend, a state funeral will be held to honour Tung, who was also a former vice-chairman of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC). There will be a...
body.zh: 本周末，香港哀悼前特首、元老董建华的去世。这位1997年主权移交给中国后成为香港首任领导人的航运大亨于9月8日去世，享年89岁，留下了坚定的管理和热忱的公共服务的遗产。本周末，将为曾任中国人民政治协商会议副主席的董建华举行国葬。将会有一个...

reflection.en: The passing of Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first chief executive after the 1997 handover, marks the end of an era for the city. His death at 89, and the upcoming state funeral, serve as a somber reminder that life's appointed end comes to all, regardless of their public stature or accomplishments. As we reflect on his legacy of service, we are reminded of...
reflection.zh: 董建华，香港1997年回归后的首任行政长官，他的离世标志着这座城市一个时代的结束。他以89岁高龄辞世，即将举行的国葬，都令人沉痛地提醒我们，生命的终点终将降临于所有人，无论其公众地位或成就如何。当我们回顾他服务奉献的遗产时，也提醒了我们共同的必死性。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Flawed AI-linked intelligence report almost led to US military boarding Chinese ship in Middle East – report
title.zh: 人工智能报告出错，美军险些在中东登上一艘中国船只

summary.en: An artificial intelligence-assisted intelligence report that was flawed nearly led to the U.S. military boarding a Chinese vessel in the Middle East earlier this year. The operation was called off after officials discovered the AI chatbot had misidentified the ship's cargo.
summary.zh: 今年早些时候，一份由人工智能辅助但存在缺陷的情报报告几乎导致美军在中东登上一艘中国船只。在官员发现人工智能聊天机器人错误识别了船上货物后，该行动被取消。

body.en: The US military came close to boarding a Chinese vessel in the Middle East earlier this year based on a flawed intelligence report prepared with the help of artificial intelligence, CNN said Friday. The US and Chinese flag. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. US intelligence indicated the ship was carrying nuclear weapons-related components, leading American forces to prepare to intercept it, the broadcaster reported, citing four anonymous sources familiar with the incident. But the operation was called off after officials determined that an AI chatbot used by an analyst had misidentified the material the ship was carrying. CNN quoted one source as saying the intelligence report was “entirely false” but “almost started a war.” It did not specify what the vessel was actually carrying or where it was bound. US Central Command — which is responsible for American forces in the Middle East — did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the reported incident. The CNN report comes after a furor erupted earlier this month when a researcher publicly resigned from leading AI firm Anthropic over fears that the technology could escape human control. Another Anthropic employee, who did not resign, said publicly that “we really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans,” and that he thought the chances were greater than “10 percent within the next decade.” Despite the warnings, US President Donald Trump and some of his key allies have voiced opposition to drastically curbing the development of artificial intelligence. US President Donald Trump arrives to deliver remarks on the economy at Mount Airy Casino Resort in Mount Pocono, Pennsylvania, on December 9, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. In a separate incident involving the US military and China, Politico reported Friday that F-35 jet parts — including a sensitive stealth canopy for a cockpit — were diverted to Hong Kong and are now missing, raising fears that Beijing had obtained sensitive American military technology. The parts were headed from Australia to the United States for repairs when the diversion occurred, the US outlet reported, adding that it was unclear why the parts were rerouted or where they are now. A spokesperson for Lockheed Martin, which manages the F-35 supply chain, said the company could not discuss specific shipments because of “security reasons.” “Lockheed Martin follows all US regulations established by the Department of War and regulated by the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) regarding the shipment of aircraft components,” the spokesperson said. “Our teams handle every shipment with the utmost diligence and safeguards to ensure the integrity of the F-35 program and...
body.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 周五称，今年早些时候，美国军方差点登上中东的一艘中国船只，原因是人工智能帮助编写的一份有缺陷的情报报告。美国和中国国旗。资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。该广播公司援引四名熟悉该事件的匿名消息人士的话说，美国情报表明这艘船载有与核武器相关的部件，导致美国军队准备拦截它。但在官员确定一名分析师使用的人工智能聊天机器人错误识别了该船携带的材料后，该行动被取消。美国有线电视新闻网援引一位消息人士的话称，这份情报报告“完全错误”，但“几乎引发了一场战争”。它没有具体说明该船实际运载了什么或开往何处。负责中东美军的美国中央司令部没有立即回应对所报道事件的置评请求。 CNN 的报道是在本月早些时候爆发的，当时一名研究人员因担心该技术可能逃脱人类控制而公开从领先的人工智能公司 Anthropic 辞职，引发了轩然大波。另一位没有辞职的 Anthropic 员工公开表示，“我们确实真诚地相信人工智能可以杀死所有人类”，并且他认为这种可能性“在未来十年内超过 10%”。尽管发出警告，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和他的一些主要盟友仍表示反对大幅遏制人工智能的发展。 2025 年 12 月 9 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达宾夕法尼亚州波科诺山艾里山赌场度假村发表经济讲话。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。在另一起涉及美国军方和中国的事件中，Politico 周五报道称，F-35 喷气式飞机部件（包括驾驶舱的敏感隐形座舱盖）被转移到香港，目前失踪，引发人们对北京获得美国敏感军事技术的担忧。据美国媒体报道，这些零件在发生转移时正从澳大利亚运往美国进行维修，并补充说，目前尚不清楚这些零件为什么要改变路线，也不清楚它们现在在哪里。管理 F-35 供应链的洛克希德·马丁公司发言人表示，由于“安全原因”，该公司无法讨论具体的发货情况。该发言人表示：“洛克希德·马丁公司遵守由战争部制定并由国防后勤局 (DLA) 监管的有关飞机部件运输的所有美国法规。” “我们的团队以最大的勤勉和保障措施处理每批货物，以确保 F-35 计划的完整性并......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence offers incredible potential, but this incident underscores the critical need for human discernment and verification. Even sophisticated tools can err, reminding us that true wisdom involves not just accumulating information, but carefully evaluating its truth and implications.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展带来了巨大的潜力，但这一事件凸显了人类辨别和核实能力的关键重要性。即使是复杂的工具也会出错，这提醒我们，真正的智慧不仅在于积累信息，还在于仔细评估其真实性和潜在影响。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: 'HK's first five-year plan won't see revised version'
title.zh: 香港首份五年规划不会有修订版

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive, John Lee, stated that the city's inaugural five-year plan will not be revised, even if it fails to meet its performance indicators. He emphasized that the reasons for any shortcomings must be explained in the Policy Address. Lee mentioned that the plan's 105 indicators, covering economic,...
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超周六表示，该市的首份五年规划不会有修订版，即使未能达到绩效指标。但他强调，政策报告必须解释导致不足的原因。李家超在电台节目中进一步解释了两份蓝图，他说，在制定本港版本的所有105项指标时，他参考了国家的五年规划，并且这些指标也是根据本港情况制定的。他强调，所有衡量经济、社会和治理进展的指标都必须实现，...

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee said on Saturday that the city’s first five-year plan would not have a revised version, even if it could not meet performance indicators. However, the Policy Address would have to explain the reasons leading to the shortcomings. Taking to the airwaves to further explain the two blueprints, Lee said he had taken reference from the nation’s five-year plans in coming up with all 105 indicators in the SAR’s version and that they had also been formulated based on the city’s situation. He stressed that all indicators, which track progress made in economic, social and governance, had to be achieved and that would happen through implementation of the annual policy blueprint. “For example, we have set an economic growth target that's in line with the global one. But then suddenly there's a conflict and global supply chains become disrupted,” he said. “Then the matter would have to be dealt with in that particular year's Policy Address.” The justification has to be thorough, he stressed. Lee points out that when an SAR chief executive carries out duty visits to Beijing, he or she will also need to report to the president on unforeseeable events. At the same time, the SAR’s leader will also need to take remedial action to ensure the public is not severely impacted, he said. The government is also proposing to enhance the 1823 service hotline, such as by adopting artificial intelligence, to identify recurring issues. Lee said the move aimed to further boost the current satisfaction rate of 4.6 points out of five. Complaints involving multiple departments often lead to overlapping responsibilities or to no one being in charge of handling the grievances, he said. If AI assigns a case to a designated department, Lee pointed out, other departments had to cooperate. The deputy chief secretary will step in when the parties involved have coordination issues and make the final decision on who shoulders the main responsibilities. As for the government’s target of resolving substandard subdivided units by 2030, he said work would be carried out in a gradual manner, but not by taking an “extreme and high pressure” approach. With the registration rate under the Basic Housing Unit regime having reached 65 percent so far, Lee said he believed that indicated a majority of the operators hope to run their business legally. The government will carry out random inspections at sites that are reported to be illegal as well as at those that are registered, he added. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周六表示，即使无法达到绩效指标，该市的第一个五年计划也不会修订版本。但施政报告必须解释造成缺陷的原因。李明博在广播中进一步解释这两个蓝图时表示，特区版本的全部105项指标是参考国家五年规划，也是根据香港的实际情况制定的。他强调，追踪经济、社会和治理进展的所有指标都必须实现，而这将通过实施年度政策蓝图来实现。 “例如，我们制定了与全球经济增长目标一致的经济增长目标。但突然之间出现了冲突，全球供应链遭到破坏，”他说。 “那么这个问题就必须在该年的施政报告中得到解决。”他强调，理由必须是彻底的。李指出，特区行政长官到北京进行职务访问时，也需要向总统汇报突发情况。他说，与此同时，特区领导人也需要采取补救行动，确保公众不受到严重影响。政府还建议加强1823服务热线，例如采用人工智能来识别重复出现的问题。 Lee表示，此举旨在进一步将目前的满意度提高到4.6分（满分5分）。他说，涉及多个部门的投诉往往会导致责任重叠，或者没有人负责处理投诉。李指出，如果人工智能将案件分配给指定部门，其他部门就必须配合。当有关各方出现协调问题时，由副秘书长介入，最终决定谁承担主要责任。至于政府到2030年解决不合格劏房问题的目标，他表示工作将以循序渐进的方式进行，但不会采取“极端高压”的方式。李说，目前基本住房登记率已经达到65%，他相信这表明大多数经营者希望合法经营。他补充说，政府将对被报告为非法的场所以及已登记的场所进行随机检查。罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: The pursuit of ambitious goals, like Hong Kong's first five-year plan, requires diligent effort and a commitment to seeing plans through. While indicators are important for measuring progress, the ultimate success of any endeavor rests on entrusting the work to a higher power. May leaders and citizens alike commit their plans and efforts to Yahweh, seeking...
reflection.zh: 追求宏伟目标，如香港的首份五年规划，需要勤奋的努力和坚持不懈的决心。虽然指标对于衡量进展很重要，但任何事业的最终成功都取决于将工作托付给更高的力量。愿领导者和市民都将他们的计划和努力托付给雅伟，寻求祂的指引和祝福。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Macau concludes first closed-door nat. security trial against ex-lawmaker and Tiananmen vigil co-organiser Au Kam San
title.zh: 澳门首次就国安案进行不公开审判，前议员欧锦新受审

summary.en: Macau has concluded its first national security trial held behind closed doors, involving former pro-democracy lawmaker Au Kam San, who faces charges including subversion. The trial is the first under Macau's expanded national security laws, with a verdict to be announced later.
summary.zh: 澳门已结束首次不公开的国家安全审判，涉及前亲民主议员欧锦新，他面临包括颠覆在内的指控。这是澳门新国家安全法下的首次审判，判决将在稍后公布。

body.en: Macau has concluded its first national security trial behind closed doors, a court said on Friday, days after proceedings began in a former pro-democracy lawmaker’s case. Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San. File photo: Au Kam San, via Facebook. A verdict will be issued at a later date, Macau’s Court of First Instance said in a statement. The Chinese casino hub expanded the scope of national security laws in May 2023, and a bill passed this year allows judges to hear national security cases behind closed doors. Au Kam San, a former Macau lawmaker who was detained in July 2025 on charges including subversion, was the first person to be arrested under the island’s new laws and the first to face a closed trial. The proceedings which opened on Wednesday have ended, the Court of First Instance said, adding that “the verdict will be delivered on a date to be scheduled later”. It said that Au, who was charged with “subversion of state power” as well as building ties with foreign groups and media outlets deemed harmful to China, “is accused of endangering national security”. Michael Polak, a London-based barrister representing 69-year-old Au, criticised the handling of the case. “The fact that the ‘trial’ of Mr Au was completed… in secret, without him being represented by independent counsel underlines the farcical nature of the proceedings,” Polak told AFP. It is “impossible for evidence to have been properly evaluated and a proper process to have been followed for such a serious offence in such a short period of time”, he said. Au Kam San (right). Photo: Au Kam-san via Facebook. The close-door trial “shielded from public and press scrutiny, because secrecy conceals miscarriages of justice”, said Jorge Menezes, a Portuguese lawyer who has practised in Macau. “It is not about justice, security, or the rule of law; it is designed to intimidate everyone into submission to the Chinese Communist Party,” Menezes told AFP before the trial. Au was one of the organisers of annual vigils in Macau — a former Portuguese territory which reverted to China in 1999 — in memory of the victims of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. Macau and Hong Kong were once the only places in China where such public commemorations could take place.
body.zh: 周五，一名前民主派议员的案件开始审理几天后，一家法院表示，澳门已完成首次国家安全审判。前澳门议员区锦新。资料图：区金山，来自 Facebook。澳门初审法院在一份声明中表示，将在晚些时候作出判决。中国赌场中心于 2023 年 5 月扩大了国家安全法的范围，今年通过的一项法案允许法官闭门审理国家安全案件。前澳门立法会议员欧锦新于 2025 年 7 月因颠覆国家政权等罪名被拘留，他是根据澳门新法律第一个被捕的人，也是第一个面临非公开审判的人。一审法院表示，周三开始的诉讼程序已经结束，并补充说“判决将在稍后安排的日期作出”。报告称，区被指控“颠覆国家政权”以及与被视为对中国有害的外国团体和媒体建立联系，“被指控危害国家安全”。 69 岁 Au 的代表律师迈克尔·波拉克 (Michael Polak) 批评了案件的处理方式。波拉克告诉法新社：“欧先生的‘审判’是秘密完成的，没有独立律师代表，这一事实突显了诉讼程序的滑稽性质。”他说，“在如此短的时间内，对于如此严重的犯罪行为，不可能对证据进行适当的评估，也不可能遵循适当的程序”。区锦新（右）。照片：区金山来自 Facebook。在澳门执业的葡萄牙律师豪尔赫·梅内塞斯(Jorge Menezes)表示，闭门审判“不受公众和媒体监督，因为保密掩盖了误判”。梅内塞斯在庭审前对法新社表示：“这与正义、安全或法治无关；其目的是恐吓所有人屈服于中国共产党。”欧是澳门年度守夜活动的组织者之一。澳门是前葡萄牙领土，1999 年回归中国，以纪念 1989 年天安门广场镇压的受害者。澳门和香港曾经是中国唯一可以举行此类公开纪念活动的地方。

reflection.en: The news from Macau describes the first national security trial conducted entirely behind closed doors. This move, following the expansion of national security laws, raises concerns about transparency and due process. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that when rulers are wicked or authoritarian, the people groan, suggesting a connection between governance and...
reflection.zh: 澳门的消息描述了首次完全不公开的国家安全审判。此举是在国家安全法扩大范围后进行的，引发了对透明度和正当程序的担忧。箴言29:2提醒我们，当统治者邪恶或专制时，百姓就叹息，这暗示了治理与公众福祉之间的联系。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Friend, leader, mentor: how political veterans remember Tung Chee-hwa
title.zh: 朋友、领导、导师：政坛元老如何缅怀董建华

summary.en: This weekend, Hong Kong mourns the loss of former chief executive and elder statesman Tung Chee-hwa. The shipping tycoon who became the city’s first leader after its transfer of sovereignty to China in 1997 died on September 8 at the age of 89, leaving a legacy of determined stewardship and dedicated public service.
summary.zh: 本周末，香港悼念前行政长官、政坛元老董建华。这位航运巨头在1997年香港主权移交中国后成为香港首任特首，于9月8日逝世，享年89岁，留下了勤勉治港、奉献公职的宝贵遗产。

body.en: This weekend, Hong Kong mourns the loss of former chief executive and elder statesman Tung Chee-hwa. The shipping tycoon who became the city’s first leader after its transfer of sovereignty to China in 1997 died on September 8 at the age of 89, leaving a legacy of determined stewardship and dedicated public service. He is remembered for steering Hong Kong through uncharted waters following the end of colonial rule, as well as his tireless efforts as a state leader and business heavyweight to...
body.zh: 本周末，香港哀悼前特首、元老董建华的去世。这位1997年主权移交给中国后成为香港首任领导人的航运大亨于9月8日去世，享年89岁，留下了坚定的管理和热忱的公共服务的遗产。他因在殖民统治结束后带领香港穿越未知领域而被人们铭记，以及他作为国家领导人和商界重量级人物的不懈努力......

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing at 89 reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 states that 'man is destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.' As Hong Kong reflects on his legacy of public service, we are called to consider our own finite time and the eternal significance of our actions.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生以89岁高龄辞世的消息，提醒我们所有人都会面对死亡这一共同的生命终点。希伯来书9章27节说：“按定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。” 香港在回顾他公职生涯的同时，也促使我们反思自己有限的生命以及行为的永恒意义。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: In Pictures: Hong Kong sex work exhibition explores violence and bodily autonomy in an underground industry
title.zh: 图片展：香港性工作展览探讨地下产业中的暴力与身体自主权

summary.en: An exhibition in Hong Kong, titled 'A Body of One's Own,' explores the history of sex work in the city. Displayed in an event space in Tsim Sha Tsui, the exhibition features items like boxes of condoms, AI-generated images of sex workers, and a computer showing a part-time girlfriends website. It is organized by three...
summary.zh: 在香港，一个名为“我身之物”（A Body of One’s Own）的展览正在探索该市的性工作历史。展览设在尖沙咀的一个活动空间，展出了避孕套盒、性工作者的AI生成图片以及一台展示兼职女友网站的电脑。该展览由三个支持性工作者的非政府组织组织：Reach Out行动、Teen's Key和午夜蓝。

body.en: Boxes of condoms, AI-generated photos of sex workers, and a computer opened up to a part-time girlfriends website sit inside Heath, an event space in Tsim Sha Tsui. AI-generated posters of sex workers at A Body of One’s Own, an exhibition about sex work in Hong Kong, at Heath in Tsim Sha Tsui. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The venue is perhaps a fitting one for A Body of One’s Own, an exhibition spotlighting the history of sex work in Hong Kong. Located in the basement of Chungking Mansions, it was once home to a string of nightclubs. The two-week exhibition is organised by three NGOs that support the city’s sex workers – Action for Reach Out, Teen’s Key, and Midnight Blue. A Body of One’s Own, an exhibition about sex work in Hong Kong, at Heath in Tsim Sha Tsui. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Wong Ka-ying, an artist and writer who curated the showcase, said the exhibition aimed not only to show pride in sex work, but also to explore themes such as violence, choice, and bodily autonomy. “Sex work is [one of] the oldest industries in the world, with over 3,000 years of history, yet the stigma around it remains pervasive,” Wong said in Cantonese during a media preview last Friday. (From left to right) Exhibition curator Wong Ka-ying, executive director of Teen’s Key Megan Yik, executive director of Action for Reach Out Cherry Chui, and director of Midnight Blue Ngai Tak-kin. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “But why, today, when human civilization has advanced so much, is our understanding and perspective on sex work still so narrow?” she said. “These are the questions we want to ask.” Wong will also lead exhibition tours this weekend, with English and Cantonese sessions available. A Body of One’s Own, an exhibition about sex work in Hong Kong, at Heath in Tsim Sha Tsui. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. As part of the media preview, the exhibition’s organisers invited four people with experience in the sex work industry to share their stories. An online sex workers’ directory at A Body of One’s Own, an exhibition about sex work in Hong Kong, at Heath in Tsim Sha Tsui. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Daphne, who describes herself as a “professional domme,” said she first got into rope play in 2022. This is her full time job, she said, adding that she also teaches rope bondage. Her interest in BDSM was first sparked when she was studying fashion design. She said she was “obsessed” with latex, and later learned through online research that she was a dominant. Daphne, a sex worker, at A Body of One’s Own, an exhibition about sex work in Hong Kong, at Heath in Tsim Sha Tsui. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. She finds most of her clients through social media, where they send her a...
body.zh: 尖沙咀 Heath 活动场所内摆放着一盒盒避孕套、人工智能生成的性工作者照片，以及一台打开兼职女友网站的电脑。在尖沙咀 Heath 举办的香港性工作展览《A Body of One’s Own》中，人工智能生成的性工作者海报。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这个场地或许很适合举办“A Body of One’s Own”展览，该展览重点关注香港性工作的历史。位于重庆大厦的地下室，曾经是一系列夜总会的所在地。为期两周的展览由三个支持该市性工作者的非政府组织——Action for Reach Out、Teen’s Key 和 Midnight Blue 组织。 《A Body of One’s Own》是在尖沙咀 Heath 举办的有关香港性工作的展览。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。策划这次展览的艺术家兼作家黄家英表示，展览的目的不仅是展示对性工作的自豪感，还探讨暴力、选择和身体自主等主题。 “性工作是世界上最古老的行业之一，已有 3000 多年的历史，但围绕它的耻辱仍然普遍存在，”黄在上周五的媒体预览中用粤语说道。 （由左至右）展览策展人黄家英、Teen’s Key执行董事易美琪、行动行动执行董事徐静茹及午夜蓝董事魏德健。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “但为什么在人类文明进步如此之大的今天，我们对性工作的理解和看法仍然如此狭隘呢？”她说。 “这些是我们想问的问题。”黄先生还将在本周末带领展览巡演，并提供英语和粤语课程。 《A Body of One’s Own》是在尖沙咀 Heath 举办的有关香港性工作的展览。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。作为媒体预览的一部分，展览主办方邀请了四位具有性工作行业经验的人士分享他们的故事。尖沙咀 Heath 举办的有关香港性工作的展览《A Body of One’s Own》中的在线性工作者名录。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。达芙妮将自己描述为“专业多姆”，她说她在 2022 年第一次接触绳索游戏。她说，这是她的全职工作，并补充说她还教授绳索束缚。她对 BDSM 的兴趣最初是在她学习时装设计时激发的。她说她对乳胶“着迷”，后来通过网上研究得知她是一个主导者。性工作者达芙妮在尖沙咀 Heath 举办的香港性工作展览《A Body of One’s Own》中。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。她通过社交媒体找到了大多数客户，他们向她发送了......

reflection.en: This exhibition in Hong Kong shines a light on the often-hidden world of sex work, bringing attention to the experiences and struggles within this industry. It highlights the importance of advocating for vulnerable populations, reminding us of the biblical call to defend the oppressed and speak up for those who are victimized. The work of these NGOs offers...
reflection.zh: 香港的这个展览照亮了常常被隐藏的性工作世界，引起人们对这一行业内经历和挣扎的关注。它强调了倡导弱势群体的重要性，提醒我们圣经呼吁要为受压迫者辩护，为受害者发声。这些非政府组织的努力为边缘化个体寻求正义和支持提供了切实的体现。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Elderly woman dies after being run over in Tai Po
title.zh: 老妇人在大埔被车撞后身亡

summary.en: A 72-year-old woman has died after being hit by a light goods vehicle in Tai Po on Friday afternoon. Police say the incident happened just after 3.40 pm when a 68-year-old man was driving his light goods vehicle along On Tai Road. When he turned left onto On Pong Road, he reportedly hit the woman as she was crossing...
summary.zh: 周五下午，一名72岁女子在大埔被一辆轻型货车撞倒后死亡。警方称，事故发生在下午3点40分刚过，当时一名68岁男子正驾驶轻型货车沿安泰路行驶。当他左转进入安邦路时，据报撞倒了正在过马路的该名女子。她头部受重伤被送往威尔斯亲王医院，当晚7点10分刚过宣告不治。警方以危险驾驶致死罪逮捕了司机。

body.en: A 72-year-old woman has died after being hit by a light goods vehicle in Tai Po on Friday afternoon. Police say the incident happened just after 3.40 pm when a 68-year-old man was driving his light goods vehicle along On Tai Road. When he turned left onto On Pong Road, he reportedly hit the woman as she was crossing the road. She was rushed to Prince of Wales Hospital with serious head injuries, where she was declared dead shortly after 7.10 pm. Police arrested the driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death. He is being detained for further enquiries. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 一名72岁女子周五下午在大埔被一辆轻型货车撞倒后死亡。警方称，事件发生在下午 3 点 40 分左右，当时一名 68 岁男子驾驶他的轻型货车沿安泰路行驶。据报道，当他左转进入On Pong Road时，他撞到了正在过马路的女子。她头部严重受伤，被送往威尔士亲王医院，晚上 7 点 10 分后不久被宣布死亡。警方以危险驾驶致人死亡罪逮捕了司机。他被拘留以接受进一步调查。罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: Life's fragility is starkly illustrated in this report from Tai Po, where a pedestrian crossing the road tragically lost her life. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a certainty for all, a sobering truth that calls us to live with purpose and compassion. In the face of such sudden loss, we are reminded of our shared human condition and the importance of...
reflection.zh: 生命脆弱的现实在大埔的这则报道中得到了鲜明的体现，一名过马路的行人不幸丧生。希伯来书9:27提醒我们，死亡是所有人的必然结局，这一令人警醒的真理促使我们要有目标地生活，并怀有怜悯之心。 面对如此突然的损失，我们被提醒要认识到我们共同的人类处境，以及珍惜每一刻的重要性。愿这一事件促使人们反思道路安全以及每一个生命的宝贵。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Lam lays down law on potential AI misues, breakouts
title.zh: 林郑月娥就潜在的AI滥用、泄露事件制定法律

summary.en: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam stated that while specific laws for governing artificial intelligence may not yet exist, this does not create a legal vacuum for addressing the misuse of the technology. In his Policy Address on Wednesday, Chief Executive John Lee emphasized that ensuring the safe use of AI is as vital...
summary.zh: 律政司司長林定表示，雖然可能尚未有專門規管人工智能的法律，但這並不意味著在處理該技術的濫用方面存在法律真空。在周三的施政報告中，行政長官李家超強調，確保人工智能的安全使用與其發展同等重要。李家超提出了七項關鍵策略，包括成立由律政司領導的專責小組，評估規管未成年人社交媒體使用及其與人工智能互動的必要性，並審查人工智能產品...

body.en: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam said laws dedicated to the governance of artificial intelligence might not yet be in place but that did not mean there was a legal vacuum to tackle misuse of the technology. In his Policy Address on Wednesday, Chief Executive John Lee stressed that ensuring the safe use of AI is just as crucial as using it for development. Lee laid out seven key strategies in this regard, including establishing a dedicated task force led by the Department of Justice to evaluate the need to regulate minors' social media use and their interactions with AI, as well as reviewing the legal liability for accidents caused by AI products. The Law Reform Commission is studying whether new legislation is required to combat deepfake-generated pornographic images and deepfake-driven online scams with a view to submitting a report to the government. Lam said on Friday the administration was deeply concerned about the potential harm that might ensue from AI misuse and pledged to expedite legislation if intervention was deemed necessary. The justice minister stressed that existing technology-neutral laws were capable of being used to prosecute those who used technology as a tool for criminal activities. “Say deception, the whole idea is that somebody used some sort of instrument or tool to facilitate his or her commission of deceptive conduct," he said. "So in this context, it doesn't matter what the tool is, how primitive, how advanced, so long as you're using some sort of instrument to facilitate the commission of a crime, that would constitute criminal conduct. “I hope that people would not be under a misapprehension that at the moment there is nothing at all to regulate the misuse of AI technology to commit criminal activities.” Lam said the task force on minors' social media use and AI interactions would be set up as soon as possible. It will collaborate with other bureaus and departments as well as study overseas practices to formulate the most suitable approach for Hong Kong in tackling this issue. “What I wish to emphasise is that legislative intervention is only one of the options, and definitely has to be coupled with other measures,” Lam said. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 律政司司长林郑月娥表示，专门针对人工智能治理的法律可能尚未到位，但这并不意味着解决该技术滥用问题存在法律真空。行政长官李家超在周三的施政报告中强调，确保人工智能的安全使用与利用人工智能进行发展同样重要。李就此提出了七项关键策略，包括成立由司法部领导的专门工作组，评估规范未成年人社交媒体使用及其与人工智能互动的必要性，以及审查人工智能产品造成事故的法律责任。法律改革委员会正在研究是否需要制定新的立法来打击深度造假产生的色情图片和深度造假驱动的网络诈骗，以便向政府提交报告。林郑月娥周五表示，政府对人工智能滥用可能带来的潜在危害深感担忧，并承诺如果认为有必要进行干预，将加快立法速度。司法部长强调，现有的技术中立法律能够用来起诉那些利用技术作为犯罪活动工具的人。 “说到欺骗，整个想法就是有人使用某种工具或工具来促进他或她的欺骗行为，”他说。 “因此，在这种情况下，无论工具是什么，多么原始，多么先进，只要你使用某种工具来便利实施犯罪，那就构成犯罪行为。“我希望人们不要误认为，目前没有任何东西可以规范滥用人工智能技术进行犯罪活动。林郑月娥表示，将尽快成立未成年人社交媒体使用和人工智能互动专责小组。我们会与其他决策局和部门合作，并研究海外做法，制定最适合香港的解决办法。林郑月娥表示：“我想强调的是，立法干预只是其中一种选择，肯定必须配合其他措施。”埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented knowledge and capabilities. As Hong Kong's justice secretary notes, the challenge lies not in a lack of laws, but in applying existing principles to new technologies. This echoes Daniel's prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times, urging us to seek wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速發展為人類帶來了前所未有的知識和能力。正如香港律政司司長所指出的，挑戰不在於法律的匱乏，而在於如何將現有原則應用於新興技術。這呼應了但以理關於末世知識增長的預言，敦促我們在駕馭這些強大工具時，尋求智慧和道德指引。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: US lawmakers hold hearing on plight of jailed media tycoon Jimmy Lai, as Hong Kong slams ‘hypocrisy’
title.zh: 美议员就黎智英案举行听证会，香港斥其‘虚伪’

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities have condemned US lawmakers for holding a hearing on jailed pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai, accusing them of colluding with "anti-China and destabilising elements" to demand his release. The government stated it "firmly rejected" the Congressional-Executive Commission on China's actions,...
summary.zh: 香港当局谴责美国议员就黎智英案举行听证会，指责他们与“反华和破坏稳定分子”勾结，要求释放他。政府声明“坚决反对”美国政府机构“国会-行政部门中国委员会”的行动，该委员会已提出一项旨在确保黎智英获释的法案。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities have condemned US lawmakers for holding a hearing on jailed pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai and colluding with “anti-China and destabilising elements” to demand his release ahead of a planned summit between Chinese leader Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump. Jimmy Lai in 2020. Photo: HKFP. The government said in a statement on Thursday that it “firmly rejected” members of the Congressional-Executive Commission on China (CECC), a US government agency that monitors human rights in China. After a hearing with Lai’s son Sebastien on Wednesday, CECC leaders introduced a bill aimed at securing the release of Lai and other “democracy advocates, journalists, former legislators, and civil society leaders” imprisoned in Hong Kong. Claire Lai was also scheduled to testify alongside her brother but pulled out due to a recent cancer diagnosis. “Jimmy Lai was sentenced to an appalling 20-year prison sentence simply for exercising his God-given rights and standing up for the people of Hong Kong,” CECC chair Senator Dan Sullivan said. “He should be released immediately.” Co-chair Representative Chris Smith called Lai’s sentence “unjust, politically motivated [and] an affront to free speech and human dignity.” ‘Nothing to do with freedom of the press’ Lai was sentenced in February to 20 years in jail, following his conviction on foreign collusion and sedition charges under the Beijing-imposed national security law. The 78-year-old was accused of using his newspaper, Apple Daily, to lobby foreign nations to impose sanctions, blockades, or other hostile activities upon China and Hong Kong. He was also accused of inciting hatred against the authorities with op-eds published in the now-shuttered tabloid. “The [Jimmy] Lai Chee-ying case has nothing to do with freedom of the press at all,” the Hong Kong government statement read, adding that “defendants have used journalism as a guise to wantonly create social conflicts, incite social antagonism, incite hatred and glorify violence, bringing harm to our country and Hong Kong.” “These countries and their politicians, including the so-called CECC, display their hypocrisy and double standards by pointing fingers at the HKSAR for our work in safeguarding national security,” it said. Ninety legislators were sworn in for the eighth term of Hong Kong’s Legislative Council on January 1, 2026 as the new term begins on the same day. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In a separate statement , Hong Kong’s Legislative Council also condemned what a spokesperson called “maliciously provocative political maneuvering and alarmist talk by some politicians.”...
body.zh: 香港当局谴责美国议员就被监禁的亲民主媒体大亨黎智英举行听证会，并与“反中乱港分子”勾结，要求在中国领导人习近平与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普计划举行峰会之前释放他。黎智英，2020 年。照片：HKFP。美国政府在周四的一份声明中表示，“坚决拒绝”美国国会及行政部门中国委员会（CECC）的成员，该委员会是一个监督中国人权的美国政府机构。周三，在与黎智英的儿子塞巴斯蒂安举行听证会后，CECC领导人提出了一项法案，旨在确保黎智英和其他在香港被监禁的“民主倡导者、记者、前立法会议员和民间社会领袖”获释。克莱尔·赖(Claire Lai)原计划与她的兄弟一起作证，但由于最近诊断出癌症而退出。 CECC 主席、参议员丹·沙利文 (Dan Sullivan) 表示：“黎智英仅仅因为行使了上帝赋予的权利并为香港人民挺身而出，就被判处了令人震惊的 20 年监禁。” “他应该立即被释放。”联合主席众议员克里斯·史密斯 (Chris Smith) 称黎智英的判决“不公正、出于政治动机，是对言论自由和人类尊严的侮辱”。 “与新闻自由无关” 黎智英根据北京实施的国家安全法被判犯有与外国勾结和煽动叛乱罪，并于 2 月被判处 20 年监禁。这位78岁的老人被指控利用他的报纸《苹果日报》游说外国对中国和香港实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对活动。他还被指控在现已关闭的小报上发表专栏文章，煽动对当局的仇恨。香港政府声明称：“黎智英案与新闻自由毫无关系。”并补充说，“被告人以新闻为幌子，肆意制造社会矛盾，煽动社会对立，煽动仇恨，美化暴力，给国家和香港带来危害。”报告称，这些国家及其政客，包括所谓的“CECC”，对香港特别行政区维护国家安全的工作指手画脚，暴露了他们的虚伪和双重标准。 2026年1月1日，香港第八届立法会九十名立法会议员宣誓就职，新一届任期同日开始。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港立法会在另一份声明中还谴责了发言人所说的“一些政客恶意挑衅的政治操弄和危言耸听的言论”。

reflection.en: The Hong Kong government's strong reaction to a US hearing on Jimmy Lai's imprisonment highlights a clash of governance narratives. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds leaders that their mandate is to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." This principle calls for rulers to prioritize the well-being and...
reflection.zh: 香港政府对美国就黎智英案举行的听证会做出强烈反应，凸显了治理叙事的冲突。《耶利米书》22:3 提醒领导者，他们的职责是“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这一原则呼吁统治者优先考虑个人的福祉和权利，特别是那些面临困境的人。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: ‘Forcing a reckoning’: How Asia is preparing for a ‘supersized’ El Niño
title.zh: 亚洲如何为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象做准备

summary.en: Governments across Asia are urgently preparing for the most severe El Niño event on record, anticipating widespread droughts, wildfires, typhoons, and floods. This extreme weather, exacerbated by human-driven climate change, is expected to bring multiple crises, including heat, heavy rain, and food shortages, to...
summary.zh: 亚洲各国政府正紧急为有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象做准备，预计将出现大范围的干旱、野火、台风和洪水。这种由人为气候变化加剧的极端天气，预计将从现在到2027年给数亿人带来包括高温、暴雨和粮食短缺在内的多重危机。

body.en: From Sri Lanka to South Korea, governments are preparing for droughts, wildfires, typhoons and floods – with climate plans facing their biggest challenge to date Asian governments are rushing preparations for the most severe El Niño weather event on record, with hundreds of millions of people bracing for multiple crises at once as extreme heat, heavy rain and food shortages hit the region. Fuelled by exceptionally warm ocean conditions across the tropical Pacific – and developing alongside the human-driven climate crisis – El Niño is virtually guaranteed to grow to a very strong intensity towards the end of this year and into 2027. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从斯里兰卡到韩国，各国政府正在为干旱、野火、台风和洪水做准备——气候计划面临迄今为止最大的挑战。亚洲各国政府正在加紧准备，应对有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺天气事件，随着极端高温、暴雨和粮食短缺袭击该地区，数亿人同时面临多重危机。在热带太平洋异常温暖的海洋条件的推动下，并与人类造成的气候危机一起发展，厄尔尼诺现象几乎肯定会在今年年底和 2027 年增长到非常强烈的强度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Asia braces for the impacts of a 'supersized' El Niño, the scale of potential devastation—droughts, wildfires, floods—underscores humanity's vulnerability to natural forces. In such times, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer a profound reminder: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This truth offers solace and a call to...
reflection.zh: 随着亚洲为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象的影响做准备，潜在破坏的规模——干旱、野火、洪水——凸显了人类在自然力量面前的脆弱性。在这样的时刻，诗篇46:1古老的言语提供了一个深刻的提醒：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”这个真理在风暴聚集之时，为人们提供了慰藉，并呼唤人们寻求坚定不移的希望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of deterring a reporter, Selina Cheng, from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment in 2024, with the company citing restructuring.
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有阻止一名记者（程晓韵）担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。程女士于2024年被任命后数周被解雇，公司方面给出的理由是重组。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The court's decision against Dow Jones underscores the importance of justice and accountability in the workplace. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God, principles that should guide all organizations, especially those involved in disseminating information.
reflection.zh: 法院对道琼斯公司的判决，凸显了职场中公正和问责的重要性。《弥迦书》6章8节提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、以及谦卑地与雅伟同行，这些原则应当指导所有组织，特别是那些从事信息传播的组织。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部低成本的喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪，该片突破了讲故事的界限。由郭嘉熙和李振杰执导的这部规模不大但结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和网红，其手法充满爱意而非恶意。故事围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……真的是这样吗？影片以一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一种竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一种写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully explores how stories, especially those surrounding mysteries and influencers, capture our attention. It reminds us that what we choose to focus on shapes our perspective. Philippians 4:8 encourages us to fill our minds with what is true, honorable, and excellent, a timely thought in an age saturated with media narratives.
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式探讨了故事，特别是围绕神秘事件和网红的故事，如何吸引我们的注意力。它提醒我们，我们选择关注什么会塑造我们的视角。腓立比书 4:8 鼓励我们将心思意念集中在凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，都应当思念，这在充斥着媒体叙事的时代尤为及时。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Hummingbird hawk moths and ivy bees: The insects thriving as temperatures rise
title.zh: 蜂鸟鹰蛾和常春藤蜜蜂：气温升高的受益昆虫

summary.en: Hummingbird hawk moths, often mistaken for small birds, are being increasingly spotted in the West Midlands region of the UK. This phenomenon, along with increased sightings of ivy bees and the wasp spider, is linked to warmer summer temperatures.
summary.zh: 蜂鸟鹰蛾，常被误认为是小鸟，在英国西米德兰兹地区被越来越多地发现。这种现象，以及常春藤蜜蜂和黄蜂蜘蛛的目击事件增多，与夏季气温升高有关。

body.en:
As parts of the West Midlands baked in warmer temperatures this summer, species once considered unusual in the region, such as hummingbird hawk moths, ivy bees and the wasp spider have been spotted in growing numbers.

The hummingbird hawk moth, known for its furry grey body, orange hindwings and long proboscis, migrates to the UK from southern Europe and north Africa in the summer months.

James Benwell, from the Birmingham and Black Country Wildlife Trust, said 2026 was a "record year" for sightings of the species, which was often mistaken for a small bird.

The moth, which can be seen hovering over flowers, has wings that beat about 80 times per second , external , according to Benwell.

"They've had a really good year this year," he said. "Normally they would come in small numbers. We'd normally hear of a few maybe. But this year, we've seen loads of records of them.

"They're absolutely amazing but I somehow haven't seen one this year, so I'm jealous of anybody else that has."

Ivy bees, which feed mainly on the nectar of ivy flowers, had also become more prevalent in the Midlands, Benwell said, adding they were easy to find on buildings.

The bees, first recorded in the UK in 2001, are slowly spreading north, after first being recorded in the region in Stourbridge in 2015.

"There's nothing that distinguishes them from other bees really, they're not that kind of attention-grabbing species, but, you know, were you to look for them, go to ivy and you'll see them," Benwell said.

Other insects that had seen an increase in their numbers locally included the clouded yellow butterfly, a European migratory species known to have "peak" years during unusually hot summers.

"Most individuals are unable to survive the British winter, but if temperatures continue to rise as a result of climate change, we may well see them becoming permanent residents," Benwell said.

"There's numerous species that we could point out that weren't here 20 years ago... and now they're quite abundant."

Others once more commonly associated with southern England have also spread further north.

The trust said the hornet hoverfly, with yellow markings that mimic a hornet to protect against predators, although it cannot sting, had become really common after it was first recorded in Birmingham and the Black Country in 2004.

Another species, the cricket bat spider, which gets its name from its cricket bat-like markings, has also become more common in grassland since it was first spotted in the region in 2019.

The sightings come as one of the UK's largest spider species, the wasp spider, was spotted in the Midlands as warmer temperatures pushed it more than 100 miles away from its usual habitat.

The spider has recently been recorded in Worcestershire, alongside sightings in...
body.zh: 今年夏天，随着西米德兰兹郡部分地区气温升高，曾经被认为在该地区不寻常的物种，如蜂鸟天蛾、常春藤蜜蜂和黄蜂蜘蛛的数量不断增加。 蜂鸟天蛾以其毛茸茸的灰色身体、橙色后翅和长鼻子而闻名，在夏季从南欧和北非迁徙到英国。 伯明翰和黑乡村野生动物基金会的詹姆斯·本韦尔表示，2026 年是该物种目击事件的“创纪录的一年”，该物种经常被误认为是小鸟。 本韦尔表示，人们可以看到这种飞蛾盘旋在花朵上，它的翅膀每秒拍打约 80 次（外部）。 “他们今年过得非常好，”他说。 “通常情况下，他们的数量很少。我们通常会听说一些。但今年，我们看到了大量关于他们的记录。 “它们绝对令人惊叹，但不知怎的，今年我还没见过，所以我嫉妒其他见过的人。” 本韦尔说，主要以常春藤花花蜜为食的常春藤蜂在中部地区也变得更加普遍，并补充说它们在建筑物上很容易找到。 这些蜜蜂于 2001 年在英国首次被记录到，继 2015 年在斯托布里奇地区首次被记录到之后，正在缓慢向北传播。 “它们与其他蜜蜂没有什么区别，它们不是那种引人注目的物种，但是，你知道，如果你去寻找它们，去常春藤，你就会看到它们，”本韦尔说。 其他在当地数量有所增加的昆虫包括云黄蝴蝶，这是一种欧洲迁徙物种，已知在异常炎热的夏季有“高峰”年份。 本韦尔说：“大多数人无法度过英国的冬天，但如果气候变化导致气温继续上升，我们很可能会看到他们成为永久居民。” “我们可以指出，有许多物种在 20 年前并不存在……而现在它们的数量相当丰富。” 其他曾经与英格兰南部更常见的联系也进一步向北传播。 该信托基金表示，大黄蜂食蚜蝇虽然不会蜇人，但身上有黄色斑纹，模仿大黄蜂以抵御捕食者，自 2004 年在伯明翰和黑人国家首次记录到这种飞蝇后，它已经变得非常常见。 另一种物种是板球蝙蝠蜘蛛，因其类似板球蝙蝠的斑纹而得名，自 2019 年首次在该地区被发现以来，它在草原上也变得更加常见。 此次目击事件发生之际，人们在中部地区发现了英国最大的蜘蛛品种之一——黄蜂蜘蛛，因为气温升高使其远离了通常的栖息地100多英里。 这只蜘蛛最近在伍斯特郡被记录下来，同时在......

reflection.en: The appearance of species like the hummingbird hawk moth in new regions, thriving under warmer conditions, points to the intricate and dynamic nature of creation. Romans 1:20 reminds us that the unseen attributes of God, like His eternal power and divine nature, are clearly perceived through what He has made. The flourishing of life, even in unexpected...
reflection.zh: 蜂鸟鹰蛾等物种在新的地区出现，并在更温暖的条件下茁壮成长，这表明了受造界的复杂和动态。罗马书1:20提醒我们，神那看不见的永能和神性，原用造成之物就可以晓得。生命的繁荣，即使以意想不到的方式，也彰显了创造主的持续作为。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Improving urban flood forecasting with real-time hazardous rainfall detection
title.zh: 利用实时危险降雨探测技术改进城市洪水预报

summary.en: The Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology (KICT) is implementing its advanced technology for detecting quasi-stationary linear rainbands and sudden localized torrential rainfall into the Urban Flood Forecasting Platform operated by the Han River Flood Control Office. This initiative aims to...
summary.zh: 韩国 civil engineering and building technology 研究所 (KICT) 将其用于检测准静止线性雨带和突发局部暴雨的早期探测技术应用于汉江洪水控制办公室运营的城市洪水预报平台。此举旨在提高城市洪水预报能力，以应对气候变化驱动的极端降雨事件日益频繁的趋势。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology (KICT) announced that it will apply its early detection technology for quasi-stationary linear rainbands and sudden localized torrential rainfall to the Urban Flood Forecasting Platform operated by the Han River Flood Control Office in Korea for urban flood forecasting.

As extreme rainfall events become more frequent due to climate change, the risk of urban flooding is also increasing. In particular, linear rainbands—narrow, elongated bands of precipitation that remain quasi-stationary over a certain area and produce large amounts of rainfall—can generate rainfall exceeding the drainage capacity of urban areas, leading to flooding.

Sudden, intense rainfall occurring over a localized area can also rapidly raise water levels in urban streams, making it a major cause of flash floods, rapid currents and incidents involving people becoming stranded.

Since November 2025, a KICT research team has participated in the Urban Flood Forecasting Task Force of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment, supporting the review of key technologies required for platform development and the establishment of operational procedures.

The team has applied its hazardous rainfall detection technology to the observation and monitoring functions of the Urban Flood Forecasting Platform, which is currently being piloted in areas including Gangnam and Kwanak in Seoul.

The technology analyzes the meteorological mechanisms and characteristics of linear rainbands and sudden localized torrential rainfall to detect and predict hazardous weather conditions likely to cause water-related disasters.

Using only weather radar observation data, the technology can identify and track the formation range and propagation path of rainbands, as well as the initiation and development processes and potential hazards of sudden torrential rainfall in real time.

The Urban Flood Forecasting Platform provides real-time detection results for rainbands and sudden downpour rainfall. This enables early identification of the likelihood of hazardous weather and provides monitoring information to support rapid assessment and decision-making regarding the potential for urban flooding, helping secure additional time for proactive response.

Dr. Yoon Seong-Sim of KICT said, "This achievement represents a notable example of putting into practice the hydrometeorological technology developed by KICT for urban water disaster response by applying it to urban flood forecasting."

She added, "Once the AI-based hazardous rainfall prediction technology is fully...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 韩国土木建筑技术研究院（KICT）宣布，将把其准稳态线性雨带和突发局部暴雨的早期检测技术应用到韩国汉江防洪办公室运行的城市洪水预报平台上，用于城市洪水预报。 由于气候变化，极端降雨事件变得更加频繁，城市洪水的风险也在增加。特别是，线性雨带（狭窄、拉长的降水带在一定区域内保持准静止并产生大量降雨）可能产生超过城市地区排水能力的降雨，从而导致洪水。 局部地区突然发生的强降雨也会使城市河流的水位迅速上升，成为引发山洪、急流和人员滞留事件的主要原因。 自2025年11月起，KICT研究团队参加了气候、能源和环境部城市洪水预报工作组，支持审查平台开发所需的关键技术和建立操作程序。 该团队已将其危险降雨检测技术应用于城市洪水预报平台的观测和监测功能，该平台目前正在首尔江南和冠岳等地区进行试点。 该技术分析线性雨带和突发局部暴雨的气象机制和特征，以检测和预测可能引发水灾的恶劣天气条件。 该技术仅利用天气雷达观测数据，就能实时识别和跟踪雨带的形成范围和传播路径，以及突发性暴雨的发生、发展过程和潜在危害。 城市洪水预报平台提供雨带和突发性暴雨的实时检测结果。这使得能够及早识别危险天气的可能性，并提供监测信息以支持有关城市洪水可能性的快速评估和决策，有助于确保有更多时间进行主动响应。 KICT 的 Yoon Seong-Sim 博士表示：“这一成果是将 KICT 开发的水文气象技术应用于城市洪水预报，将其应用于城市水灾应对的一个显着例子。” 她补充道：“一旦基于人工智能的危险降雨预测技术全面...

reflection.en: The relentless pace of technological advancement, as seen in KICT's new flood forecasting system, reflects a broader trend of increasing human knowledge. Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when "knowledge will increase," a reality we witness daily as we develop tools to understand and manage our world, even as we face complex challenges like climate change.
reflection.zh: KICT 的新洪水预报系统所展现出的技术进步的持续步伐，反映了人类知识不断增长的普遍趋势。但以理的预言谈到“知识增长”的时代，这正是我们每天所见证的现实，我们开发工具来理解和管理我们的世界，即使我们面临着气候变化等复杂挑战。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: How rural policing gaps can make escaping domestic violence harder
title.zh: 农村警务差距如何让逃离家庭暴力更加困难

summary.en: The article discusses how gaps in rural policing can exacerbate the difficulties faced by victims of domestic violence in escaping abusive situations. It cites the threats made by Daniel Billings before murdering Molly Ticehurst in April 2024, where he exploited the perceived limitations of police response in country...
summary.zh: 文章讨论了农村警务的差距如何加剧家庭暴力受害者逃离虐待困境的难度。文章引用了丹尼尔·比林斯在2024年4月谋杀莫莉·蒂斯赫斯特之前所作的威胁，他利用了乡村地区警方响应能力的局限性来恐吓她。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Before murdering Molly Ticehurst in April 2024, court documents show Daniel Billings had threatened to exploit the limits of policing in her country town: "I will come in the middle of the night … The police won't stop me. I will get to you quicker than they will."

This threat illustrates how an abuser can use the prospect of delayed access to police and justice to frighten, control or enact violence against victims.

We know that the burden of violence is uneven in Australia. In contrast to the dominant view of idyllic and crime-free rural life, violence, and indeed domestic violence, are a prominent feature in many communities.

Research shows particular characteristics of rural life —such as police availability, distance, limited services and local relationships—can restrict options.

Improving police coverage therefore means making protection readily available, safe to seek and supported after the fact.

In the year to June 2026, the recorded domestic violence-related assault rate in regional New South Wales was 73% higher than in Greater Sydney. More specifically, in the Far West and Orana regions, it was 3.4 times the state rate.

Still, much of this violence never reaches the police and, as with much rural crime, there is a significant "dark figure."

In the 2021–22 National Personal Safety Survey , 79% of women who had experienced physical or sexual violence from their current live-in partner had never told police. For previous live-in partners, this figure was 68%.

Responding to such violence is a challenge if officers are unavailable. In September 2024, New South Wales had 2,279 police vacancies , 12% of its total authorized positions.

Looking to rural areas, in the Orana Mid-Western district, a November 2024 audit found once vacancies and leave were accounted for, the police force had only 70% of its allocated workforce available.

Workforce totals and sick leave alone cannot tell us whether help will arrive when needed, and rostering matters as well. For example, a 2023 Queensland audit found staffing did not match peak evening and weekend demand.

There has been some progress over the past two years. For instance, the NSW Police now pays recruits in training and, in August 2026, 353 recruits graduated, representing the largest class in 14 years .

Still, recruitment is just the beginning. Any gains must be converted into reliable rural coverage, which also requires retaining experienced officers and covering absences.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在 2024 年 4 月谋杀莫莉·泰斯赫斯特之前，法庭文件显示丹尼尔·比林斯曾威胁要利用她乡村小镇治安的限制：“我会在半夜来……警察不会阻止我。我会比他们更快找到你。” 这种威胁说明了施虐者如何利用延迟求助于警察和司法的机会来恐吓、控制或对受害者实施暴力。 我们知道澳大利亚的暴力负担并不均衡。与田园诗般、无犯罪的农村生活的主流观点相反，暴力，甚至家庭暴力，是许多社区的一个突出特征。 研究表明，农村生活的特殊特征——例如警察的可用性、距离、有限的服务和当地关系——可能会限制选择。 因此，提高警察覆盖范围意味着提供随时可用、安全寻求和事后支持的保护。 截至 2026 年 6 月的一年中，新南威尔士州地区记录的家庭暴力相关袭击率比大悉尼地区高 73%。更具体地说，在远西部和奥拉纳地区，这是州税率的 3.4 倍。 尽管如此，大部分暴力事件从未到达警方手中，而且与许多农村犯罪一样，其中存在着重要的“黑暗人物”。 在 2021-22 年全国人身安全调查中，79% 遭受过现任同居伴侣身体暴力或性暴力的女性从未告诉过警方。对于以前的同居伴侣来说，这个数字是 68%。 如果没有警察在场，应对此类暴力行为将是一项挑战。 2024年9月，新南威尔士州有2,279个警察职位空缺，占其授权职位总数的12%。 看看奥拉纳中西部地区的农村地区，2024 年 11 月的一项审计发现，一旦考虑到空缺和休假，警察部队的可用劳动力只有其分配的劳动力的 70%。 仅凭劳动力总数和病假并不能告诉我们帮助是否会在需要时到达，排班也很重要。例如，昆士兰州 2023 年的一项审计发现，人员配备与晚间和周末高峰需求不符。 过去两年取得了一些进展。例如，新南威尔士州警察现在向新兵支付培训费用，2026 年 8 月，有 353 名新兵毕业，这是 14 年来最大的一次。 尽管如此，招聘只是一个开始。任何成果都必须转化为可靠的农村覆盖范围，这还需要保留经验丰富的官员并弥补缺勤情况。 通过 Phys.org 获取每日见解的超过 100,000 名订阅者发现科学、技术和太空领域的最新动态。报名参加我们的...

reflection.en: The tragic case of Molly Ticehurst underscores how systemic gaps in support can leave vulnerable individuals exposed to violence. The threat to exploit slow police response highlights the desperate need for robust protection for those facing domestic abuse, especially in remote areas. We are called to advocate for and defend the oppressed, ensuring that...
reflection.zh: 莫莉·蒂斯赫斯特的悲惨案例凸显了系统性的支持缺口如何使弱势群体暴露在暴力之下。利用警方响应迟缓的威胁，突显了为家庭暴力受害者提供强有力保护的迫切需要，尤其是在偏远地区。我们蒙召要为受压迫者辩护和保护他们，确保无论身在何处，人人都能获得公正和安全。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Peer sexual harassment emerges early, highlighting need for prevention before Grade 4
title.zh: 同伴性骚扰在四年级早期出现，凸显了在四年级之前进行预防的必要性

summary.en: Sexual harassment among peers begins as early as the 4th grade and persists through lower secondary school. Notably, a significant portion of those who perpetrate harassment have themselves been victims. These findings are part of a doctoral thesis in psychology by Aziz-Kaan Dönmez from the University of Gothenburg,...
summary.zh: 同伴之间的性骚扰最早在四年级就开始出现，并持续到初中低年级。值得注意的是，大多数实施骚扰的人也曾遭受过骚扰。这些是哥德堡大学心理学博士生Aziz-Kaan Dönmez博士论文中的发现，他研究了瑞典4至9年级儿童和青少年之间的同伴性骚扰。

body.en: Sexual harassment between peers begins as early as Grade 4 and continues throughout lower secondary school. Most of those who sexually harass others have also experienced harassment themselves. These are among the findings of a doctoral thesis in psychology by Aziz-Kaan Dönmez from the University of Gothenburg, who studied peer sexual harassment among Swedish children and adolescents in Grades 4–9. Dönmez will defend his thesis on October 2.
body.zh: 同龄人之间的性骚扰早在四年级就开始出现，并持续到整个初中。大多数性骚扰他人的人自己也经历过骚扰。这些是哥德堡大学 Aziz-Kaan Dönmez 的心理学博士论文的研究结果之一，他研究了瑞典 4 至 9 年级儿童和青少年的同伴性骚扰问题。 Dönmez 将于 10 月 2 日进行论文答辩。

reflection.en: The research reveals that sexual harassment is occurring among children as young as fourth graders. This deeply concerning trend underscores the urgent need to protect the vulnerable and advocate for those who are being harmed. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, a principle that is critically needed when young...
reflection.zh: 研究表明，性骚扰竟然发生在四年级这样年幼的儿童之间。这一令人深感担忧的趋势，凸显了保护弱势群体和为受伤害者发声的紧迫性。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为不能自辩的开口，这一原则在年幼的儿童遭受此类侵害时尤为重要。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Scientists hope deeper-rooted soybeans can withstand climate extremes and store more carbon
title.zh: 科学家希望更深扎根的大豆能抵御气候极端并储存更多碳

summary.en: Researchers are developing soybean plants with deeper roots, aiming to enhance their resilience to climate change effects and increase their capacity to absorb and store atmospheric carbon underground. This innovation could help mitigate climate change impacts.
summary.zh: 研究人员正在开发具有更深根系的大豆品种，旨在增强其抵御气候变化影响的能力，并增加其吸收和储存大气碳的能力。这项创新有望帮助缓解气候变化的影响。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Research scientist Ashish Rajurkar kneels in the dirt, lifting a large clod of soil tangled around a soybean plant. He knocks away pieces of earth from the plant's roots, which slope straight down instead of out to the side like typical soybean plants.

Researchers hope roots like these could help crops withstand some effects of climate change while also drawing more carbon from the atmosphere and storing it underground. Carbon dioxide released by burning fossil fuels traps heat in the atmosphere, driving human-caused climate change.

For years, scientists have explored ways to remove some of that carbon from the atmosphere, including through direct air capture, changes to ocean chemistry so seawater can absorb more carbon, and reforestation. Now, researchers at the Salk Institute for Biological Studies are testing whether deeper root systems could become another tool.

But scientists still need to show how much additional carbon those roots can store under real farming conditions, how long the carbon would remain underground and whether the crops can maintain yields.

An $18 million grant from the Bezos Earth Fund will help Salk researchers test those questions in the field by measuring how resilient these plants are to drought and other climate stressors, how much carbon they can store and for how long, and how to get the plants onto farms at scale.

Wolfgang Busch, director of the institute's Harnessing Plants Initiative, said the issue is pressing.

"We are actually steering in a direction that is very concerning," he said. "It will become harder to grow enough food for enough people."

Over the last six years, Salk scientists uncovered the genetic information of hundreds of versions of common row crop plants such as soybeans and sorghum from around the world, creating an "encyclopedia" of plant genomes, said Todd Michael, a research professor at the institute.

After identifying 347 genes related to carbon storage and root growth, scientists were able to edit the plants' DNA and create ones with roots that penetrate the soil further down.

"We wanted to leverage the natural variation of a given plant," Michael said. "We just have to be able to make the right crosses to bring in those genetics."

During droughts, they hope the roots will allow plants to access water below the top layer of soil while also storing carbon farther underground, where it may be less vulnerable to being released when farmers till their fields.

Researchers are also trying to boost carbon storage by growing larger root systems so more carbon-rich plant material is left in the soil, and by...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 研究科学家 Ashish Rajurkar 跪在泥土中，抬起缠在大豆植株上的一大块土。他从植物根部敲掉了一些泥土，植物根部直接向下倾斜，而不是像典型的大豆植物那样向侧面倾斜。 研究人员希望这样的根可以帮助农作物抵御气候变化的一些影响，同时从大气中吸收更多的碳并将其储存在地下。燃烧化石燃料释放的二氧化碳将热量滞留在大气中，导致人为造成的气候变化。 多年来，科学家们一直在探索从大气中去除部分碳的方法，包括通过直接空气捕获、改变海洋化学成分使海水能够吸收更多碳以及重新造林。现在，索尔克生物研究所的研究人员正在测试更深的根系是否可以成为另一种工具。 但科学家们仍然需要证明这些根部在真实的农业条件下可以储存多少额外的碳，碳会在地下保留多久，以及农作物是否能够保持产量。 贝佐斯地球基金提供的 1800 万美元赠款将帮助索尔克研究人员在实地测试这些问题，测量这些植物对干旱和其他气候压力因素的适应能力、它们可以储存多少碳和储存多长时间，以及如何将这些植物大规模种植到农场。 该研究所植物利用计划主任沃尔夫冈·布施表示，这个问题十分紧迫。 “我们实际上正朝着一个非常令人担忧的方向前进，”他说。 “为足够多的人种植足够的粮食将变得更加困难。” 该研究所的研究教授托德·迈克尔说，在过去的六年里，索尔克的科学家们发现了来自世界各地的数百种常见行间作物的遗传信息，例如大豆和高粱，创建了植物基因组的“百科全书”。 在鉴定了 347 个与碳储存和根部生长相关的基因后，科学家们能够编辑植物的 DNA，并创造出根部能够深入土壤的植物。 “我们希望利用特定植物的自然变异，”迈克尔说。 “我们只需要能够进行正确的杂交来引入这些遗传学。” 在干旱期间，他们希望根部能够让植物获得土壤表层以下的水分，同时将碳储存在地下更深处，这样当农民耕种田地时，碳就不易被释放。 研究人员还试图通过种植更大的根系来增加碳储存，以便更多富含碳的植物材料留在土壤中，并且通过……

reflection.en: The dedication of scientists like Ashish Rajurkar, who meticulously study the natural world to find solutions for pressing global challenges, reflects a deep engagement with creation. Their work in understanding plant biology to address climate extremes and carbon storage echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself holds profound lessons for humanity.
reflection.zh: 像阿希什·拉朱尔卡尔这样的科学家，他们一丝不苟地研究自然界以寻找紧迫的全球性问题的解决方案，他们的奉献精神体现了对受造界的深刻投入。他们通过了解植物生物学来应对气候极端和碳储存的工作，呼应了古老的智慧——受造界本身就蕴含着对人类深刻的教训。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: When a beloved tree began withering away, locals suspected a killer in their midst
title.zh: 当一棵心爱的树开始枯萎时，当地人怀疑他们中间有一个杀手

summary.en: A neighborhood's fight to save a cherished ginkgo pits them against an unlikely foe.
summary.zh: 一个街区为拯救一棵珍贵的银杏树而进行的斗争，让他们与一个意想不到的敌人对峙。

body.en:
Every summer, Seoul turns a deep green, growing dense and lush under humid skies.

"Green leaves were falling to the ground, which shouldn't happen at that time of year," recalls Jung, who lives near the streetside ginkgo in Buam-dong, a largely residential neighbourhood in the north of Seoul.

The tree is beloved by locals, who believe it has occupied its spot for more than 100 years. So Jung couldn't ignore what she was seeing. With each passing day, her curiosity turned to concern.

A rotting carpet of familiar fan-shaped leaves soon surrounded the tree, a sight so alarming Jung and her neighbours formed a crew of amateur detectives to solve the mystery: what was ailing their hardy ginkgo?

The whodunnit engrossed Buam-dong and piqued the country's interest, making national headlines. But the attention unsettled Jung, who spearheaded the campaign but has since requested anonymity - we are using a pseudonym.

"Imagine a grandfather who silently embraces you every day, listens to you, and has always been strong and full of life," she says. "Suddenly, he begins to die.

So began one community's fight to save a cherished symbol of their neighbourhood. Their unlikely enemy, who they believe plotted a surreptitious attack, was a museum built to honour a pioneering, nature-loving Korean artist.

Tucked between two mountains, Buam-dong is recommended by travellers and locals for its picturesque views, art galleries and cosy cafes - an escape from Seoul's bustle.

Because of its proximity to the Blue House, the president's official residence, urban development has been restricted, allowing the neighbourhood to retain its quaint charm.

In a place where you usually find ginkgo trees in private gardens or untamed forests, this one is special, Jung says, because it flourished on the side of the road. To her, it's "Grandpa Ginkgo".

"I pass this tree whenever I come home. I would say, 'Grandpa, I'm home.' Or 'Grandpa, I'm heading out now'."

Jung only moved here four years ago, but the grand old tree was the first thing she noticed, and she grew to love it.

To Park Jeon-hee, who has lived here for nearly all his 74 years, the ginkgo is his "oldest friend".

It's the same for 10-year-old Kim On, who walks past it every day on his way to school. It has stood since before he was born, Kim says, and "thinking it might fall down makes me sad".

So it wasn't surprising that Jung found ready allies in the community who had also noticed the ginkgo's withering leaves.

They soon became suspicious of 10 white plastic funnels peeping out from behind the trunk. Jung had initially assumed they were providing nutrients, but then began to wonder if something more sinister was at play.

body.zh: 每年夏天，首尔都会变成深绿色，在潮湿的天空下变得茂密茂盛。 “绿叶纷纷落到地上，这在一年中的这个时候是不应该发生的，”住在首尔北部主要住宅区付岩洞路边银杏附近的郑回忆道。 这棵树深受当地人的喜爱，他们相信它已经占据这个位置已有 100 多年了。所以荣格无法忽视她所看到的一切。日子一天天过去，她的好奇变成了担忧。 很快，一片由熟悉的扇形叶子组成的腐烂地毯包围了这棵树，这一景象让荣格和她的邻居们感到震惊，他们组建了一群业余侦探来解开这个谜团：他们顽强的银杏到底出了什么问题？ 这部侦探小说吸引了付岩洞的注意力，并激起了全国的兴趣，成为全国头条新闻。但这种关注让荣格感到不安，他是这场运动的带头人，但此后要求匿名——我们使用的是化名。 “想象一下，一位祖父每天默默地拥抱你，倾听你的心声，并且一直坚强而充满活力，”她说。 “突然间，他开始死亡。 于是，一个社区开始了一场拯救社区珍贵象征的斗争。他们认为不太可能的敌人策划了一次秘密袭击，是一家为纪念一位热爱自然的韩国先驱艺术家而建的博物馆。 付岩洞坐落在两座山之间，因其风景如画的景色、艺术画廊和舒适的咖啡馆而受到游客和当地人的推荐，这里是逃离首尔喧嚣的绝佳去处。 由于靠近总统官邸青瓦台，城市开发受到限制，使得该街区保留了古朴的魅力。 荣格说，在你通常会在私人花园或未开垦的森林中看到银杏树的地方，这棵银杏树很特别，因为它在路边茂盛生长。对她来说，就是“银杏爷爷”。 “每次我回家都会经过这棵树。我会说：“爷爷，我回来了。”或者‘爷爷，我现在要出去’。” 荣格四年前才搬到这里，但她首先注意到的是这棵巨大的老树，并且她越来越喜欢它。 对于在这里生活了近 74 年的朴全熙来说，银杏是他的“最老的朋友”。 对于 10 岁的金安来说也是如此，他每天上学的路上都会经过它。金说，它在他出生之前就一直矗立着，“一想到它可能会倒塌，我就感到难过”。 因此，荣格在社区中找到了现成的盟友也就不足为奇了，他们也注意到了银杏叶子的枯萎。 他们很快就对从行李箱后面探出的 10 个白色塑料漏斗产生了怀疑。荣格最初以为它们在提供营养，但后来开始怀疑是否有更险恶的东西在起作用。 她和她的邻居仔细检查了附近房子的监控录像，直到……

reflection.en: The residents of Buam-dong rallied together, acting as amateur detectives to understand why their century-old ginkgo tree was withering. Their collective concern and effort to diagnose the problem reveal a deep appreciation for the natural world and its complex systems. It reminds us of the profound wisdom woven into creation, as Psalm 104:24 observes, 'How...
reflection.zh: 布岩洞的居民们团结起来，充当业余侦探，试图找出他们那棵百年银杏树枯萎的原因。他们共同的关切和诊断问题的努力，揭示了对自然世界及其复杂系统的深刻欣赏。这让我们想起诗篇104:24所言的，创造中蕴含的深刻智慧：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造的；全地充满了你的造物。”

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: North Korea's nuclear testing may have triggered hundreds of earthquakes over several years
title.zh: 朝鲜的核试验可能在数年间引发了数百次地震

summary.en: Between 2006 and 2017, North Korea conducted six underground nuclear tests at its Mount Mantap site. While such tests typically cause a brief burst of seismic activity, geologists have observed that seismic activity has continued for years after the final detonation in a region previously considered geologically quiet.
summary.zh: 在2006年至2017年间，朝鲜在其位于咸镜北道的馒头山（Mount Mantap）的试验场进行了六次地下核试验。通常，此类试验会引发短暂的地震活动，但地质学家观察到，在最后一次爆炸多年后，该地区仍持续发生地震活动，而该地区此前被认为地质活动平静。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Between 2006 and 2017, North Korea conducted six underground nuclear tests at its vast testing site at Mount Mantap in North Hamgyong province. Typically, underground explosions trigger an intense burst of minor earthquakes that die down once testing stops. But geologists have detected far more seismic activity after the final detonation, and it has persisted for years.

The region was previously considered geologically quiet. No crustal earthquakes had been documented within 50 kilometers (31 miles) of the site for more than a century. But all that changed in 2017.

To discover exactly what was happening underground, an international research team led by Xingli Fan from Chengdu University of Technology analyzed 17 years of continuous seismic wave data recorded between 2008 and 2025. The data came from regional monitoring stations in China and South Korea, located 80 kilometers (50 miles) to 200 kilometers (124 miles) away.

They also used a sensitive pattern-matching technique called matched-filter detection to find smaller, hidden tremors that standard earthquake monitoring networks usually miss.

Their findings, published in the journal Science , challenge long-held assumptions about how the Earth responds after an underground blast.

Rather than fade away as expected, the seismic activity near Mount Mantap steadily increased and accelerated through 2025. In total, the team detected 1,399 small local earthquakes. "Seismicity at Mt. Mantap continued to increase for years after the final test," the study authors wrote.

They also mapped the precise locations of 955 of these tremors and discovered they were not randomly located. Instead, they lined up along two distinct, roughly parallel tracks stretching away from the test site.

One of these tracks followed the projected continuation of a fault line geologists already knew about. The second track revealed what appeared to be a completely hidden fault that had never been mapped before. The scientists concluded that the underground explosions had damaged the crust around pre-existing structural weaknesses. But what puzzled them was how explosions that ended years ago were still driving fault movements today.

To explain this long delay, the researchers ran computer models to see how the weight and shape of Mount Mantap affected stresses in the rock beneath it.

They found that the mountain itself played a major role, as its steep, heavy slopes put intense natural pressure on the rock directly beneath it. When the six nuclear explosions blasted through Mount Mantap, they damaged this already stressed rock and weakened the...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 2006年至2017年间，朝鲜在咸镜北道万塔山的大型试验场进行了六次地下核试验。通常情况下，地下爆炸会引发强烈的小地震，一旦测试停止，这些地震就会消失。但地质学家在最后一次爆炸后发现了更多的地震活动，并且这种活动已经持续了多年。 该地区此前被认为地质安静。一个多世纪以来，距该地点 50 公里（31 英里）范围内没有记录到发生过地壳地震。但一切在2017年发生了变化。 为了准确了解地下到底发生了什么，成都理工大学范兴丽领导的国际研究小组分析了2008年至2025年间记录的17年连续地震波数据。这些数据来自中国和韩国的区域监测站，距离80公里（50英里）至200公里（124英里）。 他们还使用了一种称为匹配滤波器检测的敏感模式匹配技术来发现标准地震监测网络通常会错过的较小的隐藏震动。 他们的研究结果发表在《科学》杂志上，挑战了长期以来关于地球在地下爆炸后如何反应的假设。 到 2025 年，万塔山附近的地震活动并没有像预期那样消失，而是稳步增加并加速。该团队总共检测到了 1,399 次当地小地震。研究作者写道：“在最终测试后的几年里，曼塔普山的地震活动持续增加。” 他们还绘制了 955 次地震的精确位置图，发现它们并不是随机定位的。相反，他们沿着两条截然不同的、大致平行的轨道排列，这些轨道从测试地点延伸出去。 其中一条轨迹是地质学家已知的断层线的预计延续。第二条轨迹揭示了一个似乎完全隐藏的断层，以前从未在地图上绘制过。科学家们得出的结论是，地下爆炸破坏了先前存在的结构弱点周围的地壳。但令他们困惑的是，多年前结束的爆炸如今为何仍在推动断层运动。 为了解释这种长时间的延迟，研究人员运行了计算机模型，以了解曼塔普山的重量和形状如何影响其下方岩石的应力。 他们发现山本身发挥了重要作用，因为其陡峭而沉重的斜坡对正下方的岩石施加了巨大的自然压力。当六次核爆炸穿过曼塔普山时，它们损坏了这块已经受压的岩石并削弱了......

reflection.en: The persistent tremors following North Korea's nuclear tests serve as a stark reminder of how destructive actions can have long-lasting, unforeseen consequences. This echoes the biblical call to actively overcome destructive forces, not by mirroring them, but by choosing a path of healing and restoration, even when the damage seems to linger.
reflection.zh: 朝鲜核试验后持续不断的震动，鲜明地提醒我们，破坏性行为会产生持久的、意想不到的后果。这呼应了圣经的呼召，要积极地克服破坏性的力量，不是以牙还牙，而是选择一条治愈和修复的道路，即使在破坏似乎仍然存在的时候。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

He plans to discuss solutions to the 'arrow of time' problem in his upcoming lectures. The article mentions Bryan Johnson's attempt to inject plasma from his son for anti-aging purposes, which he...

Continue reading...

Yet, as physicist Jim Al-Khalili suggests, this pursuit may be a distraction from the fundamental reality of our mortality. The ancient wisdom of Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a fixed point in human life, a truth...
reflection.zh: 一些最富有的人对永生的不懈追求，凸显了人类面对有限存在的深刻挣扎。然而，正如物理学家吉姆·阿尔-哈利利所言，这种追求可能分散了我们对生命终将逝去的根本现实的注意力。希伯来书9:27中的古老智慧提醒我们，死亡是人类生命中一个确定的节点，这一事实可以让我们珍惜当下拥有的时光。
